# Clinozy launch — kickoff plan

> **Status: approved on 2026-10-03,** after re-planning against the Oct 2 drop
> (phone and tablet designed, the 18 spec files re-extracted from the prototype,
> `schema-routes.md` read in full). The four REDs of 2026-10-01 stand
> (D17–D20); the eight of 2026-10-03 (D23–D30) and every Appendix D default were
> taken as recommended defaults under your instruction to finish and approve
> without stopping — each is in `plans/decisions.md` and can be reopened by moving
> the iteration back to `planning`. `fe-kickoff-iteration` builds §3–§8 in ledger
> order (§9), each screen through `fe-design-ditto`; what was actually built is
> recorded in `AS-BUILT.md`. The received files are in `intake-files/`; every
> `file:line` below refers to them.

## 3. Foundation (before any screen)

### 3.1 Theme preset `clinozy-zinc-pastel`

**Full-surface.** Today's named presets override only primary, ring, sidebar and
chart; this one sets every surface token. Values are the prototype's: H:11
(light), H:12 (dark, `@media screen` only) and H:14 (the light-pinned panels).
The regenerated `preset.md` and the brief JSON (`design-brief-preset.md:43–67`)
now equal the prototype in both modes, so no md-versus-prototype colour conflict
remains (B.1 T2–T6). Built by `fe-theme-axis-audit`; verified by
`fe-design-ditto` (L-53).

**Reuse check:** `[data-base='zinc']` (`src/index.css:336–361`) is shadcn zinc.
It matches the light surfaces (white page, `#f4f4f5`, `#e4e4e7`) but not dark
(the prototype's cards are `#141417`, canvas `#0e0e10`, borders `#2c2c31`). The
preset carries its own surfaces; the zinc base stays untouched for other looks.

**Ramp naming.** `preset.md:25–43` now names every step by its raw `--z*`
variable (Tailwind zinc numbering plus `--z0` white and the off-scale `--z150`)
and gives the `--color-neutral-*` alias in its own column. The aliases sit one
step lower (neutral-100 = `--z50` … neutral-800 = `--z700`; neutral-900 =
`--z900`; H:197), and `--z800` `#27272a` has no alias. The previous spec printed
alias numbers as zinc steps; that off-by-one is fixed. This plan and Appendix E
use the `--z*` names and hex values.

Tone rules (`preset.md:64`), as utilities: text sits in ink on bg; a selected
state is an ink fill with `background` text (`bg-tone-<t>-foreground
text-background`); a selected chip adds `ring-1 ring-tone-<t>-foreground`; the
tab-tint hover `color-mix(in oklch, bg 45%, --z0)` is `hover:bg-tone-<t>/45`
over the `background` header (the same colour), with an inset 1px
`ring-tone-<t>-foreground/16`; status dots carry a 3px halo
`ring-3 ring-tone-<t>-dot/18`. Options without a tone of their own hash to sky ·
sage · lav · butter · blush · mint (H:3875). Stone is the "How data
connects" tone (out, D2) and the fallback (`TN.stone`, H:2978).

**Colour map.** The prototype paints with 13 neutral steps (`--z*`) and 127
accent variables (`--k*`). Appendix E maps each to a token, with its ΔE (OKLab
distance, the larger of light and dark), recounted against the current
prototype:

- 74 map exactly (48 to existing or tone tokens, 26 to new tokens): 7,612 live
  uses.
- 30 (83 uses) sit within ΔE 0.03 of a token and map to it.
- 33 (137 uses, one to eight each) are farther. They map to the nearest token
  and are confirmed side by side (L-57); if a comparison fails, add a tone step,
  never a raw value.
- 3 (`--k83`, `--k84`, `--k85`) are referenced only by the dead `ProfileLogic`
  view model (H:3077, H:3218, H:3240; B.12) and are not built.

The 27 new tokens take their values from the prototype colour they replace:

| Token                                                   | From                                                | Role                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `canvas`                                                | `--z50`                                             | page-level tint under white cards: table header strip, rails, file canvas, row hover (569 uses)                                                                                 |
| `muted-strong`                                          | `--z150`                                            | skeleton fills, progress tracks, keyboard-focus fill, sort-header hover (124 uses; `preset.md:32`). Replaces the previous plan's `hover`: the hover fill is `--z100` = `accent` |

The names are proposals for the theme-catalog review (L-03); the values are
not. No digits in names.

Raw colour literals in the markup map too:

- `rgb(0 0 0 / α)` shadows (about 250 uses) → the preset's elevation overrides
  (below);
- `rgb(9 9 11 / α)` → `overlay` at the alphas listed above;
- `rgb(255 255 255 / .55)` and `/ .85`, the segmented hover and press
  (H:230–231) → `background/55` and `background/85` (fixes dark, below);
- white alphas on the Photo viewer chrome and photo captions (H:829, H:2683–2684,
  H:2800) and the thumbnail pill `/ .92` (H:772) → `canvas/α` and `background/92`
  inside the light-pinned scope;
- `rgb(161 161 170 / .25)` field halo (H:298, H:3803, H:3921) → replaced by the
  focus ring (§7.3);
- `rgb(244 244 245 / .75)` past-time veil (H:2062, H:2075) → `muted/75`; the
  calendar grid's data-URI lines `%23fafafa` / `%23f4f4f5` (H:2061, H:2074) →
  `canvas` and `muted` hairlines;
- `rgb(24 24 27 / .08 · .03 · .12)` (H:1829, H:4789, H:6121) → `primary/8`,
  `/3`, `/12`;
- `#333` and `#555` (print only, H:437–453, H:506, H:511, H:4422–4426) →
  `foreground` and `muted-foreground` in the light-locked print scope;
- `#dc2626` / `#b91c1c` / `#fca5a5` ("Remove lead", H:1820) → `destructive`
  with the platform ring (§7.3); the unread `--destructive: #dc2626` (H:240) is
  dropped;
- `#DD2A7B` → `channel-instagram`; `#d4d4d8` / `#e4e4e7` (H:4077) are the
  viewport-simulator chrome and are not built.

**Dark mode.** User menu › "Appearance" Light · Dark · System, default Light;
System follows `prefers-color-scheme`; print stays light (`preset.md:100`). The
build uses the platform mode (`.dark` + `useThemeStore`, §3.3); the preset's
dark block mirrors H:12, and a print rule forces the light tokens, as the
prototype's `@media screen` scoping does. Shadows, backdrops and both greens do
not change in dark.

- **Light-pinned panels (H:14, `preset.md:45–47`).** In dark mode the Bulk
  actions bar and the Photo viewer re-declare the light ramp with one change:
  `--z900` = `#27272a`. Built as one preset rule,
  `.dark[data-theme='clinozy-zinc-pastel'] [data-surface='light-pinned']`, that
  re-declares every neutral token's light value with `primary` = `#27272a`
  (screen only). The bulk bar (`bg-primary text-primary-foreground`) holds
  14.27 in dark (16.97 light); without the rule it flips to a light bar, and the
  Photo viewer's names fall to `#0e0e10` on `#0a0a0c` (1.03). The build also
  applies the scope to the photo-tile caption bar (`[data-imgbar]`, H:829,
  H:2800) and the thumbnail category pill (H:772), which fixes two of the gaps
  below.
- **Places the prototype leaves unthemed** (`preset.md:102–110`), each fixed
  (§7.3):

  | Surface                                                     | Prototype in dark                                  | Ratio                        | Built as                                                               | Ratio         |
  | ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
  | Segmented hover / press (H:230–231)                         | `rgb(255 255 255 / .55 · .85)` under `--z900` text | 2.56 / 1.23                  | `hover:bg-background/55`, `active:bg-background/85`, `foreground` text | 16.96 / 17.30 |
  | Photo-tile captions (H:829, H:2800)                         | `--z50` over the scrim                             | 1.23                         | light-pinned scope                                                     | 15.03         |
  | Thumbnail category pill (H:772)                             | white / .92 pill, `--z700` text                    | 1.30                         | light-pinned scope                                                     | 8.84          |
  | Calendar grid and past-time veil (H:2061–2062, H:2074–2075) | hard-coded light lines and veil                    | bright lines, `#bcbcbe` veil | `canvas` / `muted` hairlines, `muted/75` veil                          | themed        |
  | "Remove lead" (H:1820)                                      | `#dc2626`, hover `#b91c1c`, `--z0` text            | 3.81 / 2.84                  | the shadcn `destructive` button (`hover:bg-destructive/90`)            | 5.59 / 4.72   |

**Shape and density**

- **Radius** (shape axis `uniform`, `design-brief-preset.md:33`; recounted:
  8px ×784, 50% ×481, 999px ×463, 6px ×404, 12px ×220, 4px ×128, 2px ×27, 10px
  ×7). Base `--radius-lg` 0.5rem gives `rounded-xs` 2 (search mark, 2–3px
  bars), `rounded-sm` 4 (kbd, inline skeleton bars), `rounded-md` 6 (24–30px
  icon buttons, steppers, tags, tab triggers, tooltip, skeleton blocks),
  `rounded-lg` 8 (buttons 36 / 32 / 44px, fields, pickers, nav tabs, list cards,
  toasts), `rounded-xl` 12 (panels, popovers, menus, the list table card, the
  command menu, the uploads tray, the floating drawer "×") and `rounded-t-2xl`
  16 (phone bottom sheets). Chips, count badges, the "Previewing as" pill, the
  phone floating action button, the tab-bar active pill (46 × 28px), switch and
  progress tracks are `rounded-full` with `data-slot="pill"`; avatars and status
  dots are `rounded-full` (exempt). `0 8px 8px 0` (×11) is `rounded-e-lg`
  (logical). Drawers are square; below `md` the list table card is square too.
  The 10px phone tab-bar buttons take `rounded-lg` (no 10px step; §7.2).
  (`preset.md:189`.)
- **Elevation** (axis `soft`, separation `border`; `design-brief-preset.md:34–35`).
  The preset scopes the prototype's shadows onto the platform's `[data-slot]`
  surfaces (`src/index.css:455–520`), the same in both modes (`preset.md:191`;
  the platform's dark `soft` card uses .35, which the preset overrides): table
  card `0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.04), 0 4px 16px −8px rgb(0 0 0/.06)`; dropdown
  panels `0 16px 40px −12px /.22, 0 4px 12px −4px /.08`; command menu
  `0 24px 64px /.22, 0 4px 12px /.08`; drawers `−16px 0 40px /.16` (H:882;
  lead panes .14, H:1754); toast and menus `--shadow-lg`; secondary buttons
  `--shadow-sm` (H:201); floating "×" `0 4px 14px /.18`; uploads tray
  `0 12px 32px /.14`; phone floating action button `0 10px 28px −8px /.45`
  (H:55). Separation: 1px `border` between regions and around cards; 1px `muted`
  between table rows; a 3px inline-start row edge, transparent unless the screen
  tones it (`preset.md:192`). Below `md` drawers lose their shadow and start
  border (H:26).
- **Density by viewport** (D23). The prototype has two switches: the layout
  mode, phone below 760px (H:2993), and a padding switch, compact whenever the
  window is narrower than 1440px or shorter than 800px (H:6129, also the row
  padding H:3751 and the step groups H:3842); phone replaces both with its own
  column (H:4078). The build keeps the 1440 × 800 switch exactly and moves the
  phone boundary to `md`:

  | Tier (D23)                                     | Prototype                          | Padding column |
  | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------- |
  | below `md` (< 768)                             | phone < 760                        | phone          |
  | `md`–`xl` (768–1279)                           | tablet 760–1099, desktop 1100–1279 | compact        |
  | ≥ `xl`, narrower than 1440 or shorter than 800 | desktop 1100–1439                  | compact        |
  | ≥ 1440 wide and ≥ 800 tall                     | desktop                            | comfortable    |

  The values are preset CSS variables (compact by default; `@media (min-width:
90rem) and (min-height: 50rem)` → comfortable; `@media (max-width: 47.9375rem)`
  → phone), read as `p-(--room-toolbar-pad)` and the like. They are not the
  platform `--spacing` axis, which stays `cozy` (`design-brief-preset.md:32`,
  note 6). Values (`preset.md:200–217`, H:4078, H:6129):

  | Variable (prototype key)                        | Comfortable                       | Compact                         | Phone (below `md`)                                                                                            |
  | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | Header side padding (`pg`)                      | 20px                              | 12px                            | 12px                                                                                                          |
  | Header min-height                               | 60px                              | 60px                            | 52px, gap 8px (H:21)                                                                                          |
  | Toolbar and file-bar padding (`hp`)             | 16px 20px                         | 12px 12px                       | 8px 12px                                                                                                      |
  | Table card margin (`bm`)                        | 0 20px 20px                       | 0 12px 12px                     | 0; card full-bleed, square, no side borders, no shadow                                                        |
  | Table side padding (`tx`)                       | 20px                              | 16px                            | 14px                                                                                                          |
  | Inline-start padding after the 3px edge (`tx3`) | 17px                              | 13px                            | 11px                                                                                                          |
  | Table row                                       | 10px 20px 10px 17px               | 10px 16px 10px 13px             | 12px 14px 12px 11px, gap 6px 12px                                                                             |
  | Drawer header padding (`dh`)                    | 14px 24px                         | 12px 20px                       | 10px 16px                                                                                                     |
  | Drawer header height (`hh`)                     | 76px                              | 76px                            | 60px                                                                                                          |
  | Drawer side inset (`dx`)                        | 24px                              | 20px                            | 16px                                                                                                          |
  | Drawer body (`db`)                              | 20px 24px 28px                    | 16px 20px 20px                  | 14px 16px 20px                                                                                                |
  | Form grid gap (`fg`)                            | 16px 12px                         | 12px 10px                       | 12px 10px; the 88px label column stacks above its field, gap 6px (H:32–34)                                    |
  | Step group                                      | 14px 16px                         | 12px 14px                       | 12px 14px                                                                                                     |
  | Drawer footer                                   | 12px 24px, gap 10px, 36px buttons | 12px 20px                       | wraps; 10px 12px + safe-area; 44px buttons, padding 0 12px, gap 8px; hint under the buttons at 12px (H:35–38) |
  | Row actions                                     | 30 × 30px icon, 32px labelled     | tablet tier ≥ 36 × 36px (H:141) | ≥ 40 × 36px on their own line                                                                                 |
  | Page h1                                         | 20px                              | tablet tier 18px (H:148)        | hidden (H:45)                                                                                                 |

  So the h1 is `max-md:hidden md:text-lg xl:text-xl` (18 / 20px); desktops
  1100–1279 get 18px instead of 20px (D23 Standing deviation). The view
  model's 5px compact row (H:3751) has no control (`densBtn`, H:4153,
  unreferenced) and is not built.

- **Focus** (`preset.md:194`, H:266): keyboard focus is a `muted-strong` fill
  with `primary` text, 120ms ease; 1.15 / 1.17 against the page, under WCAG
  1.4.11. The build keeps the fill and adds the platform ring (focus axis
  `ring`, `design-brief-preset.md:37`): `ring` on the fill is 15.43 / 14.25. The
  open search or picker field's `disabled` border and 3px halo (2.56 / 2.73 and
  1.22 / 1.55; H:298, H:3803, H:3921), the caret-only plain inputs (H:244) and
  "Remove lead"'s `#fca5a5` outline all take the same ring (§7.3). The j/k row
  highlight (`[data-kfocus]`: inset 2px `border-strong` on `canvas`, H:267) is
  a selection cue, kept.
- **Motion** (axis `smooth`; `preset.md:193, 221–263`). The keyframes become
  `--animate-*` tokens, named without digits: dropdown in / up 160ms
  cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) (`czddin` / `czddup`, H:213–214); drawer 340ms
  cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) with its backdrop (`czdrawer` / `czbd`,
  H:251, H:253); floating "×" 200ms after 200ms (`czpop`); bulk bar 220ms
  cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) (`czbulk`); revealed sections 240ms
  cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) (`czacc`); fade 150ms (`czfade`); spinner 700ms
  linear (`czspin`, declared twice, H:212 and H:249). **Phone:** bottom sheets
  rise with `czsheet`, 260ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), translateY(28px) and
  opacity 0 → none, origin bottom centre (H:18): the picker list (max 72%,
  backdrop `overlay/40`, H:39–40), filter panels (max 82%, no dim, H:41), and
  All sections / Patient file sections (max 80%, H:43–44); the tab-bar active
  pill fades its background in 160ms. Skeletons are a flat `muted-strong` fill:
  the prototype's sweep is invisible (background-position on a flat fill,
  H:269–270), so none is built. Toasts have no animation and dismiss after
  5200ms (H:4539–4542; `preset.md:254` says 4500ms, from the dead
  `ProfileLogic` timer H:3172, B.1 T14). Reduced motion: every duration 1ms
  (H:15); the platform's reduce handling covers it. Nine keyframes are declared
  but never used and are not built: `czdrin` (H:255), `czsplIn` (H:293),
  `czsplBeat`, `czsplGone`, `czsplGrow`, `czsplTrack` (H:299–302), `czsplLet`,
  `czsplRip` (H:310–311), `czbreath` (H:314).

**Type, fonts and scrollbars**

- **Fonts:** self-host `@fontsource/inter` (400, 500, 600, 700) and
  `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` (400, 500). The platform stacks already name both
  (`src/index.css:96–98`), but nothing loads them today; CSP `font-src 'self'`
  (`src/lib/csp-api-origin.ts:103`, `index.html:37`) blocks the prototype's
  Google Fonts link (H:193–194; `preset.md:183`). `body` sets
  `font-feature-settings: "cv11", "ss01"` and −0.005em letter-spacing (H:245).
  The dependency and `pnpm-lock.yaml` land in one atomic commit (L-02).
- **Type scale** (`preset.md:179–182`): 10.5 · 11 · 11.5 · 12 · 12.5 · 13 ·
  13.5 · 14 · 15 · 16 · 18 · 20 · 23px, display numerals 26 and 32px. Page h1
  20 / 1.2 / −0.015em (tablet tier 18, below `md` hidden: the header shows the
  section chip, 14 / 600 / −0.01em, 28px tall). Drawer title 18 / 600 / −0.01em,
  subtitle 13 `muted-foreground`. Today greeting 23 / 600 / 1.1 / −0.02em
  (H:580); Visit sheet name 21px (H:2474). Body 13 (paragraphs 1.45–1.55);
  field values 13.5; cells 13 with 12–12.5 secondary lines; buttons 13 / 500;
  field labels 12 / 500 `muted-foreground-strong`; eyebrows 11 / 600 uppercase
  +0.05em; table header 11 / 600 uppercase +0.03em; chips 12 / 500; tooltip
  11.5 / 500 / 1.3; tab-bar labels 10.5 (500, active 600); mono kbd 10–11, lead
  id 12 / 500, contact id 11.5 / 500; counts, money, dates and times
  `tabular-nums`. The brief sets type scale `compact`
  (`design-brief-preset.md:29`), and the 10.5–11.5px steps fall under the
  platform's 12px floor (`docs/reference/preset-product-design-rules.md` P-2,
  T-1, T-2). AMBER, default: keep the type-scale axis at `default` (P-2) and
  build the design's steps, the sub-12px ones included, as named rem text
  tokens in `@theme` (never `text-[…px]`); confirm at L-03.
- **Scrollbars:** 10px, transparent track, pill thumb `border-strong` with a
  3px transparent border, `disabled` on hover; Firefox `thin`, `border-strong`
  (`muted-foreground` while the container is hovered); `scrollbar-gutter:
stable` on overflow containers and inside modal dialogs; table-header strips
  hide theirs (H:407–413, H:424–425; `preset.md:276`). The earlier 8px rule
  (H:207–211) is overridden and dead. `::selection` is `border` (H:204).

**Axes** (`design-brief-preset.md:22–42`, explained in its note 5): accent
colour `emerald` (nearest enum to hue 150; the preset's tokens win), base
`zinc`, harmony `triadic`, intensity `muted`, contrast `normal`, density `cozy`,
type scale `compact` (AMBER), fonts `inter` / `inter`, radius `default`, shape
`uniform`, elevation `soft`, separation `border`, focus `ring`, motion `smooth`,
menu `default`, icons `lucide` at weight `thin` (1.5 for the prototype's 1.6,
H:3073; D13), layout width `full`. Contrast, harmony, separation, shape, focus,
motion, elevation and density equal the platform defaults (`presets.ts:148–295`);
base (`neutral`, :91), icon weight (`regular`, :107), layout width
(`contained`, :172), intensity (`balanced`, :247) and type scale (`default`,
:285) differ. `ThemePreset` is `{ id, label }` only (`presets.ts:1–4`), so
nothing can carry axis defaults yet although `README.md:47` says a token preset
may: AMBER (L-04).

**The four registration points** (`docs/design-workflow/prompts/README.md:52–60`):

1. **`src/index.css` theme blocks:** `[data-theme='clinozy-zinc-pastel']` and
   `.dark[data-theme='clinozy-zinc-pastel']`, holding every token above, the
   density variables, the light-pinned scope and the elevation overrides; tone
   and new-token defaults go in `@theme`.
2. **`src/index.css` swatch:** `.theme-dot-clinozy-zinc-pastel` (beside
   `src/index.css:390–414`). The picker draws `theme-dot-*` only for accent hues
   (`AppearancePanel.tsx:221`) and lists named presets as text (`Choices`,
   `:403–407`), so no preset swatch is drawn today: register it anyway and log
   the gap (L-04).
3. **`src/shared/theme/presets.ts`:** add `{ id: 'clinozy-zinc-pastel', label:
'Clinozy Zinc Pastel' }` (`design-brief-preset.md:18`) to `THEME_PRESETS`;
   set `DEFAULT_PRESET` to it and add `BASE_PRESET = 'default'` for the stock
   palette (`README.md:58–60`; no code has it yet), with a persisted-preference
   migration test.
4. **`public/theme-init.js`:** `PRESET_PRIMARY['clinozy-zinc-pastel']` = light
   `['oklch(0.21 0.006 285.9)', 'oklch(0.985 0 0)']`, dark
   `['oklch(0.967 0.001 286.4)', 'oklch(0.165 0.004 285.9)']`
   (`design-brief-preset.md:45–46, 57–58`), and update
   `boot-theme-vars.drift.test.ts`.

Then `pnpm validate:tokens && pnpm validate:theme-axis && pnpm
validate:theme-catalog && pnpm type-check`; update the theme catalog docs and
`docs/reference/theming.md`; run `fe-theme-axis-audit`.

### 3.2 Shell: new variant `sectionBar`

One header bar and no sidebar on any viewport (`shell.md:7–8`, H:522–553). It is a
**new** fifth `AppLayout` variant (`variants/AppLayoutSectionBar.tsx`), never an
overwrite of `topNav`. Built by `fe-design-ditto` with `shadcn`, `fe-rtl-logical-css`,
`fe-i18n-constants`, `fe-e2e-testids` and `fe-test-generation`. Tiers per D23: phone
< `md`, tablet `md`–`xl`, desktop ≥ `xl`; the prototype switches at 760 / 1100
(H:2993), a Standing deviation.

- `nav` aria-label "Sections", `data-slot="mobile-nav"`, `md:hidden`, `fixed
inset-x-0 bottom-0`, height `calc(58px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`, padding

- Slot: column, gap 3px, `rounded-lg` (the design's 10px is not a named step; §3.1, §7.2),
  no tap highlight; icon pill 46×28 `rounded-full` + `data-slot="pill"`, background
  160ms; label 10.5px, line-height 1.1, ellipsis.
- Slots 1–4: the first four pinned rooms the role can see (default Appointments ·
  Leads · Patients · Payments), icon 16px. Current: pill `bg-tone-*`, icon and label
  in tone ink, 600, `aria-current="page"`; others: label `muted-foreground-strong`,
  icon `muted-foreground`, 500.
- Slot 5 "More": aria-label "All sections", `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `Compass` 18px.
  When the current room is not in slots 1–4 its label becomes that room's name and it
  takes that room's tone (tone pill, tone ink, 600); otherwise it reads "More" and its
  pill turns `bg-muted` while the sheet is open. Opens the All sections sheet.
- **Extend, don't fork:** `MobileNav` (`AppLayout.shared.tsx:348–379`) gains tone-
  aware items and an optional trailing "More" slot. Its height and safe-area padding
  apply to every shell (today it has none), so `--floating-bottom-offset`
  (`index.css:969–976`) becomes `3.625rem` (58px); consumers keep adding
  `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` themselves (the `ConsentBanner` precedent).

  grid row to the parent, so it renders below the screen (findings, `_report.md:13`).

  floating "New" (+16px, inline end, above the pill when one shows) → upload tray →

**Navigation model**

- Order and icons (`shell.md:39`; `_patterns.md:297–299`): Today `House` · Leads
  `UserPlus` · Appointments `Calendar` · Patients `Users` · Medical `Pill` · Clinic
  stock `Package` · Payments `Wallet` · Tasks `SquareCheck` · Offerings `Tag` · Users
  `Shield`. Tones per §3.1 (`shell.md:42`). A room shows only with View access
  (`useVisibleNav` over the manifests and `useClinicAccess`, L-12, L-25); Today
  always shows. No counts anywhere in the nav (`shell.md:44`).
- **Measured fold** (every width ≥ `md`; pure function `fitPinnedTabs(widths,
available, currentIndex)`, unit-tested):
  - tab width = 20 + 16 + 6 + label width at 600 13px + 2 (H:4074);
  - available = header inner width − 20 − mark − 4 − (All sections wrapper + 6) −
    (each other right-cluster item + 6) − 170 (the search keeps 170px) (H:4084–4085;
    `shell.md:75`);
  - all fit → all show; otherwise 84px is kept for "More", the current tab is kept,
    then pins in order until the first that does not fit; the rest fold into "More"
    (H:4087–4093);
  - re-measured by a `ResizeObserver` on the header and its right cluster and after
    `document.fonts.ready` (H:4083). The prototype measures 855px at 1440 (all four
    fit) and 251px at 1024 and 820 (current + "More"). Without "How data connects"
    the budget grows by 38px — verify the 820 / 1024 result at build (AMBER).
- The prototype's hover-open "More" (`navHovIn` / `navHovOut`, 120 / 220ms, H:6082)
  is bound nowhere and its "Not pinned · shown while open" tab (H:537) never renders
  (`temp` is set only for patient-file tabs, H:4940). Neither is built; an unpinned
  current room shows through the All sections button tint.
- **Keyboard** (`shell.md:46`; H:3165, H:4511): G toggles All sections; 1–9 then 0
  open the 1st–10th room of the role's visible list; both only outside text fields
  and without modifiers. ⌘K / Ctrl K toggles ⌘K; "/" focuses the visible list search;
  Esc closes the top-most surface. These are live in the prototype, so Q-S2 closes:
  build them and add their rows to `KeyboardShortcutsDialog`.

**Make-it-live contract:**

1. `APP_SHELL_VARIANT.sectionBar = 4`; `loadSectionBarShell` appended at index 4 of
   `APP_SHELL_LOADERS` (`app-layout-variants.ts`, index-aligned with the ids);
   `PREVIEW_VARIANTS = [sectionBar, sidebar, topNav, rail]` (`resolve-app-shell.ts`).
   The default, non-persisted `appVariant` 0 then resolves to `sectionBar` for team
   deployments; personal-only still resolves to `focus`.
2. `SHUFFLE_TEMP.appLayout` stays `false` (`presets.ts:835`), so shuffle never rolls
   the shell.
3. `appVariant` stays out of persistence (`useThemeStore` partialize deletes it,
   `useThemeStore.ts:260`), so no stored value can override the default.
4. `resolve-app-shell.test.ts` pins item 1; `preloadSessionAppShell` warms the
   `sectionBar` chunk; shell test ids (header, tab-bar slots, All sections rows and
   pins, Account-menu rows, branch picker, View-as pill) follow `fe-e2e-testids`.

The `fe-design-ditto` surface-audit table (`SKILL.md:204–217`) has four errors, fixed
in L-11:

- the mobile trigger is Sidebar-only;
- the settings entry is in `UserMenu` in all four variants;

- the launcher's last item is keyboard shortcuts, not devices.

**Never in Zustand:** no record (patient, lead, appointment, invoice and so on).
TanStack Query owns them. The lead-hold days (default 3, H:4013) are an org
setting served by the fixture, not a device preference. The viewport mode is
not state: layouts switch with Tailwind tiers (D23); the few JS branches the
prototype has (`VP()`, e.g. Week hidden on phone) read one `useViewportTier()`
hook over `matchMedia` at the `md` / `xl` boundaries (§3.5, L-07a).

### 3.4 Icons

Registry only (`@/shared/icons/index.ts`; D13). Each add is four edits:
`index.ts` (`makeIcon`, the Lucide import renamed on the import side, e.g.
`Maximize2 as LuMaximize`), `icon-names.ts` (the union), `iconset-tabler.ts`
and `iconset-phosphor.ts`; the `Record<IconName, …>` type forces a Tabler and a
Phosphor equivalent for every name (all listed below exist in the installed
`@tabler/icons-react` 3.48 and `@phosphor-icons/react` 2.1). Built by
`fe-design-ditto`; tests through `fe-test-generation` (`icon-registry.test.ts`,
`index.test.tsx`).

Glyphs were re-checked path by path against every icon source in the
prototype: the registry `ICONS` (H:3006–3071, 64 keys, `bell` declared twice at
H:3017 and H:3041), the picker set `ddI` (H:3912: `chev`, `down`, `x`, `check`,
`search`, `plus`, `minus`, `more`), the sort arrows `PATHS` (H:3733–3734), the
table toolbar's `svg()` helper (H:4127–4132) and the inline Activity glyph
(H:5001), and against the icon tables of the regenerated specs
(`_patterns.md:295–325` and each screen's Icons section).

**Stroke.** `ICONS` draw at 1.6 (H:3073); `ddI`, `PATHS` and `svg()` at 2. The
build sets the icon-weight axis to `thin` (1.5, `presets.ts:102–106`;
`design-brief-preset.md:40`), and the registry's stroke is one CSS variable
(`svg.lucide { stroke-width: var(--icon-stroke) }`, `src/index.css:916–919`), so
the 2px picker chevrons, ticks, × and sort arrows also draw at 1.5: a Standing
deviation (§7.2).

**Viewport.** Icons do not change by tier except where the shell says so: the
phone tab bar draws its section icons at 16px and `Compass` at 18px
(`_patterns.md:300`); below `md` the header search is a 36px icon-only button
(`shell.md:23`). Directional glyphs (`ChevronLeft` for Back, `ChevronRight` for
next / open, `PanelRightOpen` / `PanelRightClose`) mirror under RTL with
`rtl:-scale-x-100` (`fe-rtl-logical-css`); the money arrows and `Send` do not.

### 3.5 Shared primitives (built once, before any screen)

The prototype duplicates its table markup in six rooms and its chat column five times
(I1; H:851, H:1844, H:1937, H:2186, H:2845). The rebuild has **one** of each, in
`src/shared/components/` (folder-per-unit). Every primitive is built at phone, tablet
and desktop together (`fe-design-ditto`), with `shadcn`, `fe-rtl-logical-css`,
`fe-i18n-constants` (chrome in `common`), `fe-e2e-testids` and `fe-test-generation`.

**Tiers in code.** Tailwind tiers carry almost everything: base classes are the phone,
`md:` the tablet, `xl:` the desktop (D23). One new hook, `useViewportTier()`
(`src/shared/hooks/useViewportTier/`; `phone | tablet | desktop` from `(min-width:
48rem)` and `(min-width: 80rem)` through `useSyncExternalStore` over `matchMedia`), is
used only where the markup itself changes: popover ↔ bottom sheet, tooltip off, the
lead drawer's panes, Week view (D27).

**Spacing set per tier** — the §3.1 density variables (comfortable / compact / phone
column; H:4078 over H:6129; `_patterns.md:10–21`; `shell.md:74`). Every primitive reads
them (`p-(--room-toolbar-pad)` and the like), so the phone values — toolbar 8px 12px,
gutter 0, table sides 14px, drawer header 60px at 10px 16px, drawer body 14px 16px
20px — arrive without per-component breakpoints.

**Bottom stack on phone** (one CSS contract in `src/index.css`, next to the existing
`:has()` offset rule; D30): `--floating-bottom-offset` = 58px (the tab bar); a notice
pill publishes `--floating-notice-height` (52px while shown) and a floating "New"
publishes `--floating-fab-height` (60px while mounted, `:root:has([data-slot='fab'])`).
Bottom to top: tab bar → notice pill (centre, +14px) → floating "New" (inline end,
+16px + notice) → upload tray (inline end, + FAB) → toasts (centre, top layer). Every
value adds `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`. The Sentry feedback trigger, which owns the
bottom inline-end corner (`docs/reference/design.md:153–157`), hides below `md` while a
floating "New" is mounted — the consent-card precedent in `index.css` (§7.2).

**Record drawer** — `mkDrawer` (H:3754–3853), on shadcn `sheet` anchored to the inline
end; create / show / edit drawers are URL-driven dialog routes (D24), stacked children
are component state (S:116).

- **Width:** `min(W, 100vw − 56px)`; automatic W = 840px when any non-compact items
  field is present, 560px for light forms (≤ 8 fields and no textarea, upload, teeth,
  price, stock or > 5-option chip group), else 680px; screens may pass 600 · 720 · 820
  · 900 · 1040 (H:3850; `_patterns.md:28`).
- **Motion:** overlay `bg-overlay/45` (`czbd`) and panel `czdrawer` 340ms
  cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); panel shadow −16px 0 40px rgb(0 0 0 / .14) → elevation
  token (H:1754).
- **Floating ×:** outside the inline-start edge, top 14px, 36×36, `rounded-xl`,
  `bg-card`, shadow 0 4px 14px /.18, "×" 18px, aria-label "Close"; `czpop` 200ms after a
  200ms delay on every drawer (the prototype animates only some, `_patterns.md:31`).
- **Header:** 76px, padding per tier, hairline; title 18px/600 −0.01em; optional tag
  pill (22px, `bg-muted`, 11.5px/500); sub line 13px `muted-foreground`; badge row
  (24px pills); "Quick fill" row (11px uppercase label + dashed 24px chips "⚡ <label>")
  (`_patterns.md:32`).
- **Body:** vertical scroll only; 6-column grid — full (textarea, uploads, items, big
  chip groups), half (names, pickers), third (numbers, mobile, dates, codes ≤ 16); the
  last field of a row stretches (`_patterns.md:33`).
- **Field anatomy:** label 12px/500 `muted-foreground-strong` + required mark
  `destructive` + optional hint (`muted-foreground`, ellipsis); input 36px `rounded-lg`
  13.5px `px-2.5` with an optional `bg-muted` prefix tile ("+91") or suffix; textarea
  9px 10px, 13.5px/1.45, `resize-y`; chips 24px pills 12px/500; switch 34×20, 16px knob;
  upload zone 96px, 1.5px dashed `border-strong`, `rounded-xl`, `bg-canvas`. Same
  sizes on phone (`_patterns.md:34`). Reuse `input`, `textarea`, `switch`, `label`.
- **Steps** (`accordion`, single, collapsible; H:3816–3852; `_patterns.md:40–49`):
  cards `rounded-xl`; open = `bg-card` + `border-strong`, closed = `bg-canvas` +
  `border`; head = 24px circle (11px/600) + title 13.5px/600 + hint "Edit" (done) /
  "Open" (later). Circle: open = section-tone ink fill, white number; done = `success`
  "✓"; missing a required field = `destructive` "!"; later = `bg-border` with its
  number. Collapsed peek: grid auto-fit min 150px, gap 6px, indent 34px — uppercase
  10.5px/600 label + value 12.5px clamped to 2 lines; empty → dashed "Empty"; multi →
  20px pills up to 4 then "+N"; items → one tile "<N> added" / "None yet" + up to 6
  chips then "+N"; missing fields → "Missing: <fields>"; a click opens the step. Each
  open step ends with a 32px outline "Next: <step title> →". Body `czacc` 240ms. A
  single section of ≥ 4 fields splits into Details / Payment / Notes; more than 3 groups
  merge into 3 (H:3816–3823).

  13px/500: summary (12.5px `muted-foreground`, ellipsis) · "Delete" (`destructive`
  fill, only when deletable → confirm) · close ("Cancel"; "Back" in a stacked child;
  "Close" when read-only) · "Save & add another" (where offered) · "Not saved · your
  changes are kept" with a 6px dot (after a failed save) · primary (`bg-primary`;
  "Save" or the screen's label; "Saving…"; "Retry save"). Save is never disabled: with
  an unfilled required field it opens that step (H:3852; `_patterns.md:36`).
  Read-only: "View only · your role can’t change this" (H:3755).

  record on top; the parent stays; saving closes only the child and selects the new
  record in the parent field (`_patterns.md:37`).

  focus goes to the drawer title (the design moves nothing, `_patterns.md:38`). A dirty
  drawer arms `useUnsavedChangesGuard`, so ×, Cancel, backdrop, Esc and the browser
  Back all ask before discarding (Q-P1 revised, AMBER).

  `muted-foreground-strong`: 18px tone circle with a 12px icon · text (ellipsis) · time.
  Merged oldest → newest with the conversation, from the person's appointments (+
  reminders), prescriptions, treatments, invoices, payments, check-ins, reviews and task
  outcomes. Strings (`_patterns.md:184–193`), icon, tone, target:
  - "Appointment #<id> · <service> · <status> · <doctor>" — `Calendar`, status tone →
    `/appointments/$appointmentId`;
  - "Reminder sent · <service> · <date time>" — WhatsApp, sage, not clickable;
  - "Rx #<id> · <medicines> · <doctor>" — `Pill`, sage → `prescriptions`;
  - "<treatment> · session <n> · <therapist>" — `Sparkles`, lav → `treatments`;
  - "<type> invoice #<id> · <₹ bill> · <₹ due> due" / "… · Paid" — `Receipt`, butter
    when due else sage → `invoices`;
  - "Received <₹ amount> · <mode> · #<invoice>" / "Refund …" — `Wallet`, mint →
    `payments`;
  - "Check-in · <feeling> · <score>/10 · after <service>" — `MessageSquare`, sage (blush
    when Worse) → `overview`;
  - "<source> review · <rating>★" — `Star`, butter (blush at ≤ 3★) → `overview`;
  - "Task · <title> → <result>" — `CheckCircle`, plum, not clickable.
    Times "Today 4:00 pm" · "Tomorrow" · "Yesterday" · "9 Oct 4:00 pm" via
    `useLocaleFormat`. Section targets use the D26 slugs. The prototype joins history by
    name (H:3985–3992) and its `star` icon is missing (H:3991) — ids and a `Star` export
    (§7.3).
- **Messages:** bubbles max 68%, padding 9px 13px, `rounded-lg`, 13.5px/1.45; outgoing
  (inline end) in the channel tone bg + line (WhatsApp sage, Instagram blush, SMS butter,
  Email lav), incoming (inline start) in the channel tone mixed 55% with `card`; call log
  sky; note butter with a dashed line. Meta 11px: sender ("<team member>", "… · call",
  "… · note", or the contact's first name; hover → team card "Sent this") · 12px channel
  glyph · time · delivery ("· Sent" / "· Delivered" / "· Read" in `success-strong` / "·
  Queued" in butter ink / "Sending…" / "Not sent" + a 22px "Retry"). Delivery is
  stored as the schema's `delivery_status` (S:1119–1126: queued, sent, delivered, read,
  failed) and shown with the prototype's labels (D22): `queued` → "Sending…", or
  "Queued" while WhatsApp is down; `failed` → "Not sent" + "Retry".
- **Empty:** dashed card (1px `border-strong`, `rounded-xl`, padding 18px 14px):
  "No conversation yet" (12.5px/600) + the situational line + three 28px starter chips;
  a chip switches to WhatsApp and fills the box (H:5796–5798). Lines, starter sets and
  starter texts verbatim (`_patterns.md:171–178`); the clinic name and maps link come
  from org / branch settings, never the "Cresence Skin" / "maps.app/cresence-skin"
  literals (§7.3).
- **Composer:** top hairline, padding 10px <table sides> 12px, background = the chosen
  channel's tone (200ms). Row 1: "Send via" segmented control (`role="tablist"`, track
  padding 3px, 32px buttons, 14px glyphs; labels only when the column is ≥ 460px,
  H:5770): WhatsApp (only if the contact is on WhatsApp) · Instagram (disabled at 45%,
  tooltip "No Instagram on this contact") · "Call log" (`Phone`) · "Note" (`PenLine`);
  selected = solid `channel-whatsapp` / `channel-instagram` / `channel-call` /
  `channel-note` with a white glyph, 600. Then, wrapping: reply hint or mismatch chip,
  outage line, preference warning. Box: 1px border in the channel ink, `rounded-xl`,
  `bg-card`; textarea 3 rows (min 60px), 13.5px/1.5, maxLength 1000; ↵ sends, Shift+↵
  breaks. A "Fill in" row of dashed butter chips for {{variables}} ("address" · "maps
  link" · "day time" · "review link"). Bottom bar: "Suggest" (`Sparkles` 14px, 30px,
  12px/600; tooltip "Suggestions and templates · or type /") and a 30px Book button
  (`Calendar` 15px, aria-label "Book an appointment", tooltip "Book an appointment ·
  reason from their message") — both hidden for Call log and Note — then send (30px,
  `Send` 13px, filled in the channel colour). Placeholders, send labels, hints, outage
  and preference strings verbatim (`_patterns.md:160–170`).
- **Suggestions popover:** above the box, full composer width, 8px gap, max-height
  340px, padding 12px, `rounded-xl`, shadow-lg, `czddup` 160ms: `Sparkles` + "Suggested
  for <First>" + × ("Close suggestions"); smart chips (28px pills, 13px icon, 12px/600)
  picked from the contact's last message; label "Templates · type / in the box to
  search"; template rows (24px tone tile + name 12.5px/600 + preview 11.5px ellipsis).
  Typing "/" first opens it and filters by the text after "/"; picking fills the box and
  closes it; empty "No template matches “<query>”". Chips, templates and the Explain text
  verbatim (`_patterns.md:179–182`).
- **Drafts:** unsent text is kept per thread in memory while moving between people and
  restored on return, never across reloads (H:5645; `_patterns.md:157`) — a module-level
  map, not a persisted store.
- **Side effects** (server rules, fixture now; `_patterns.md:158`): the first outgoing
  reply on a New or Re-targeted lead sets Contacted ("Status → Contacted (first
  reply)"); a call logged on a New lead does the same ("Status → Contacted (call
  logged)"); sending on another channel makes it the lead's default; during a WhatsApp
  outage WhatsApp messages stay "Queued".
- **States:** the host's skeleton; a failed message "Not sent" + "Retry"; outage
  "WhatsApp down · replies will queue".

**Toasts** — **reuse** `notify` and `AppToaster` (H:2690, H:4539–4542;
`_patterns.md:231–238`).

- A bottom-centred bar, `role="status"`, padding 10px 16px, gap 14px, `rounded-lg`,
  `bg-primary` / `primary-foreground` 13px, shadow-lg, max width 80%, no enter animation.
  Action: an outline button (1px `border-disabled`, `text-border-strong`,
  padding 3px 10px, `rounded-lg`, 12.5px) — "Undo" by default, "Retry" for failures.
- 5,200ms; failures 9,000ms (H:4542; the 4,500ms `toast()` at H:3172 is an earlier,
  overridden definition). Toasts with Undo stay 10,000ms — the schema's restore window
  (S:1546, D32).
- The prototype adds Undo to any text containing removed, deleted, cancelled,
  discarded, archived or stopped (H:4540); here each of those mutations passes an
  explicit Undo action.
- **Bottom offset:** `calc(1rem + var(--floating-bottom-offset, 0rem) +
env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0rem))` through Sonner's `offset` — 16px on desktop and
  tablet, 16px above the tab bar on phone (design 76px = 18px above it, H:77–78); phone
  max width `calc(100% − 24px)`, width fits the text.
- **Above every overlay** — drawers, the Visit sheet and bottom sheets; the prototype's
  z 50 puts toasts under them (H:2690 vs H:2468; §7.3).
- The Clinozy default position is `bottom-center` (`DEFAULT_TOAST_POSITION` is
  `top-right`, `presets.ts:808`; changed with a persisted-preference migration, as the
  preset's). The platform keeps up to 4 visible (`AppToaster.tsx:37`); the design
  replaces the current toast (AMBER).

**Tooltip** — **reuse** `tooltip` (H:426, H:4467–4472; `_patterns.md:240–246`):
`bg-primary` / `primary-foreground` 11.5px/500, line-height 1.3, nowrap, padding 5px
8px, `rounded-md`, 4px arrow; 8px above the control, centred, 6px from the viewport
edges, flips below; shows 160ms after hover (fade + 2px rise, 120ms); hides on scroll,
wheel, key press and 60ms after a click; on touch screens a tap shows it for 1,400ms
(tablet). Every row-action and icon button with an aria-label gets one. **Phone: never
shown** (H:94) — `TooltipContent` renders nothing below `md`; the aria-label carries the
name.

**Contact and team cards** — one `PersonCard` unit per kind: shadcn `hover-card` for a
pointer, `popover` opened by a tap on touch screens (`_patterns.md:209–229`). Fetch
first, then show — never a skeleton popover (`_patterns.md:275`).

- Contact: 320px, max-height `min(520px, free space)` and at least 200px; placement
  below → above → inline end → inline start (below when ≥ 260px is free), 6px gap, 8px
  viewport margin, origin at the anchored corner; `rounded-xl`, shadow 0 16px 40px −12px
  /.22 + 0 4px 12px −4px /.08, `czddin` 160ms; opens 280ms after hover, closes 220ms
  after leaving; hovering the card keeps it (H:4524–4533).
- Team: 320px, shadow-lg, same placement; opens 160ms after hover, closes 200ms after
  leaving (H:4534).
- **Phone:** a tap opens the same 320px card, clamped 8px inside the screen; the tap
  does not also open the row (AMBER). Content per §6.0.
- In Users, hovering a team row opens a patient contact card (H:3746, H:4524) — the
  team card instead (§7.3).

**Empty state** — **reuse** `EmptyState` (H:4129–4130; `_patterns.md:283`): 96px dashed
ring, tinted 68px disc, 40px `bg-card` tile with the room icon 18px, 10px and 6px dots;
title 15px/600; hint 12.5px (max 320px); optional 36px primary. With filters applied:
`Search` icon, "No matches", "Nothing matches these filters. Clear them to see everything
again." + "Clear filters". Fallback title "Nothing here yet". Per-room copy from each
room's spec.

**Skeletons** — **reuse** `skeleton` (H:269; `_patterns.md:282–286`): content replaced in
place by flat `bg-muted-strong` bars (0.72em tall, `rounded-md`, widths cycling 64 / 48 /
60%); avatars stay round, icons hide, inputs become `rounded-lg` bars; clicks off. Tables
keep their header; drawers show bars in the top-most scroll area; the picker shows 4
rows (62 / 48 / 70 / 40%). The specs' 1.1s / 1.2s shimmer animates `background-position`
on a flat fill and never moves (H:260, H:269), so no sweep is built (§3.1).

**Cells** — tone pill; person cell (avatar, name, sub, "P" badge); avatar stack (+N); id
pill (22px `bg-muted`); money cell — ₹ with Indian grouping (`inrF`, H:3563) and "−"
U+2212 for negatives, from integer paise (S:4) through `useLocaleFormat`.

**Upload tray** — **reuse** clinozy-be generic uploads (`_patterns.md:248–255`):
`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, aria-label "Uploads"; fixed, inline-end 20px,
bottom 20px, 320px, max-height 320px, `rounded-xl`, shadow 0 12px 32px /.14, `czddin`.
Header 40px, 12.5px/600: "Uploading <left> of <total>…" → "All uploads complete". Rows:
28px tile (`Camera` on blush for images, `FileIcon` on stone) · name 12.5px/500
(ellipsis) over a 4px bar (`primary` → `success` when done, 150ms) · "<n>%" → "✓ <size>"
("1.2 MB", "84 KB"); a finished row leaves after 1,400ms; the tray closes when empty.
Over the limit: toast "<n> file(s) over 10 MB skipped" (photos 15 MB; Q-P5). **Phone:**
bottom `calc(var(--floating-bottom-offset) + 20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) +
var(--floating-fab-height, 0px))` — the prototype has no phone rule and sits on the tab
bar (`_patterns.md:252`; D33).

**Print templates (invoice, sale, Rx)** — add. H:434–514: A4 210 × 297mm, Arial 3.25mm,
letterhead space 38.1mm top and 23.3mm at the inline start; 260ms → rAF →
`window.print()`, cleanup on `afterprint`. Clinic name, phone and GSTIN come from org /
branch settings, never the "Cresence Skin" literals (H:510–511).

The photo viewer is the patient file's alone (§6.6).

**shadcn primitives to add** (`pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add …`, `shadcn` skill): `sheet`,
`drawer` (adds `vaul`), `command` (then `CommandPalette` moves onto it), `tabs`,
`toggle-group`, `hover-card`, `accordion`, `scroll-area`, `radio-group`, `resizable`
(adds `react-resizable-panels`). Reused as installed: `popover`, `dropdown-menu`,
`tooltip`, `alert-dialog`, `dialog`, `skeleton`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `select`, `input`,
`textarea`, `label`, `badge`, `avatar`, `separator`, `progress`, `calendar`. Each new
dependency and its `pnpm-lock.yaml` land in one commit (`fe-dependency-management`).

### 3.6 Data layer and contracts

- **The contract is `schema-routes.md`** (D22), byte-identical in clinozy-be:
  - Conventions (`S:3–10`): money is integer paise; phones E.164
    `^\+91[6-9]\d{9}$`; timestamps ISO UTC; calendar dates `YYYY-MM-DD` and
    clock times `HH:mm`, clinic-local (Asia/Kolkata); the primary key is a uuid
    and the display id a per-organisation `seq` with the schema's prefix
    (`#2841`, `PT-0412`, `PAY-`, `INV-` / `S-`, `CN-`, `CR-`, `PO #`; D32,
    supersedes Q-X4).
  - Every entity carries `_Common` (`organizationId`, audit and soft-delete
    fields); delete is soft, with Undo for 10s through `POST …/restore`
    (`S:132–134, 1546`; D32).
  - Lists are cursor pages of 50 (`S:1540`, D7).
  - The 58 enums are the stored values; labels come from the prototype (D1).
  - The 104 operations (`S:1537–1754`) name the api functions, one per
    operation.
- **Plan-only additions** — UI the prototype shows that the contract doesn't
  carry. Each is a fixture field marked `REPLACE_WITH_API` and a backend
  request in Appendix F: the Visit model (D18), the Visits section (D26),
  `recall` view, abilities and custom roles (D9, Q-U2), lead hold / claim,
  saved views, the day-close entry check, payment reference and attachment,
  pending settle-by and "Use on next bill", the offering fields (offer price,
  branch availability, GST-inclusive, search terms, description), medicine
  Rx-only / near-expiry flags, the extra task kinds and outcomes, the
  appointment package, the patient consent set and language, several phones /
  Instagram / default channel on a contact.
- **Where code lives:**
  - Domains used by two or more rooms (patients, leads and contact threads,
    appointments, staff, branches, offerings, invoices and payments, tasks,
    preferences) go in `src/shared/api/clinic/`, as `<domain>-contracts.ts`,
    `<domain>-api.ts` and `<domain>.fixtures.ts`.
  - Room-private domains go in the island, as `<room>.contracts.ts`,
    `<room>.api.ts` and `<room>.fixtures.ts`.
- **Contracts:** Zod schemas; types are inferred, never hand-written.
  - Relations are by id. The prototype joins by name (B, D, E reports), and
    that is a defect.
  - There is no Contact entity (D32, `S:251–262`): a contact is the lead or
    patient record; chat-only threads are leads with `kind = contact_thread`;
    walk-in buyers are `MedicalContact`.
  - Branded ids reuse `src/core/types/branded.ts` (`PatientPublicId`,
    `AppointmentPublicId`, `InvoicePublicId`) and add the rest.
- **Hooks:** Query hooks wrap the api functions. Mutations go through
  `useAppMutation` (single-flight) with toasts, and Undo where the prototype
  offers it. Today and Tasks refetch every 60s (`S:1577, 1582`).
- **Fixtures** are seeded from the prototype's seed data and converted to the
  contracts. The prototype's duplicate patient sets (`PT_SEED` vs `PATIENTS`)
  merge into one. The prototype's seeds come first so side-by-side screenshots
  match; the PRD's sample records (PRD.md:153) are added alongside.

### 3.7 Access

- **Contract** (D9, D22): the schema's role × section matrix with View /
  Create / Edit / Delete (`S:211–225, 1009–1021`) over its fixed role enum —
  Admin, Owner, Doctor, Therapist, Front desk, Counsellor, Pharmacist,
  Accountant, Marketing (`S:996–1007`). The prototype seeds 7 of them (no
  Owner, no Marketing; H:3565); Owner is the platform org owner and Marketing a
  seeded role (Q-U2). The 11 abilities and custom roles are plan additions
  (Appendix F).
- **Route gate:** `gatewayFromManifest` (session → module → permission
  `organization:read`), then `requireOrgStatus` — the existing leaf pattern.
  The org index sends each role to its home (D25).
- **In-room:** `useClinicAccess()` returns `can(section, action)`,
  `canAbility(key)` and the preview role. It reads the fixture matrix
  (`US_PERM0`, `US_ABIL0`) for the member's clinic roles; access is the union
  across roles, and Admin is always full.
  - Effects match the prototype: create buttons hide (H:405), row actions filter
    (H:4566), drawers go read-only (H:3755).
- **Gaps the prototype left open, closed here:**
  - the palette respects access (H:4600–4603);
  - alias rooms don't bypass (H:3315);
  - the Users room is gated (H:5143);
  - Pay and Day close are gated (G report);
  - Remove lead and Save lead are gated (D report).

  Which screens enforce the nine unused abilities is Q-U8.

- **Users (D17)** gates on real platform codes, not the fixture matrix: the route
  needs `membership:read`; inviting, removing and changing roles need
  `invitation:manage`, `membership:manage` and `role:manage`. The fixture matrix
  still governs the clinic modules.
- **View-as:** `previewRole` narrows `useClinicAccess`. Where "Exit preview"
  lands is Q-U11. Its "Previewing as <role>" pill (H:554) rides
  `--floating-bottom-offset` below `md`, above the tab bar and the floating
  "New" button (the prototype lets it cover the button — §7.3).

### 3.8 Copy, i18n and formats

- **Namespaces (11 new):** `today`, `leads`, `appointments`, `patients`,
  `patient-file`, `medical`, `clinic-stock`, `payments`, `tasks`, `offerings`,
  `users`. Generic table and drawer chrome goes in `common`; shared clinic
  vocabulary (statuses, roles, the chat column) goes in `clinic`.
- **Per namespace:** `namespaces.ts`, 11 loaders (`i18n-resources.multi.ts`),
  11 JSON files, `localizedRoute([NS])`, and `<ROOM>_NS` / `<ROOM>_KEYS`
  constants. Manifest titles need bootstrap keys. A new namespace needs a
  dev-server restart (`fe-i18n-constants`).
- **Parity gate:** all 11 UI locales must carry every key (no partial locales).
  The source of the 10 non-English files is Q-X1.
- **Copy source:** the regenerated specs quote every string verbatim from the
  prototype (`_report.md:7`); phone-only strings (the section chip, "Close
  lead", "Lead panels", "Back to roles", the "In system · " prefix) are keys too.
- **Print and message languages:** English / ગુજરાતી / हिंदी (Rx print, Visit
  sheet) are not UI locales — Gujarati isn't one. Q-X2.
- **Formats** (`useLocaleFormat`, never bare `Intl`):
  - ₹ with Indian grouping; contracts carry paise (D22).
  - Dates: "Wed 30 Sep 2026", "27 Sep – 3 Oct", "Sep 24 · 15:39"; clinic-local
    calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) use the civil-day opt-in.
  - Relative time: "Just now", "N min ago", "Yesterday", "N days ago".
  - IST shown in full-date titles (H:6149).
  - Phones display "+91 98765 43210" and are stored E.164.

## 4. Route / island map

The route map is `schema-routes.md`'s (D22, D24): every page, every
`dialog-over` drawer and every redirect it lists, with three plan changes —
the patient file's sections are literal folders with the D26 slugs, `/visits/$visitId`
carries the D18 Visit model, and the view enums follow D27. Every clinic island
lives under `src/pages/organization/$organizationSlug/`, the org guard boundary,
registered as a child of the org route (`addChildren`,
`src/app/routes/routeTree.tsx:560–563`) with the existing leaf pattern:

- `beforeLoad`: `if (preload) return`, then
  `gatewayFromManifest(manifest)(toGateContext(location, params))`, then
  `requireOrgStatus`;
- `head: manifestHead(manifest)`;
- `errorComponent: RouteErrorBoundary`;
- `lazyRouteComponent(localizedRoute([NS], …))`.

The URL column omits the `/organization/$organizationSlug` prefix. "Access" is
the schema's column; the route itself gates on membership plus module (D9), and
in-room View / Create / Edit / Delete come from the fixture matrix seeded per
§3.7. A URL-driven dialog is a direct child folder whose `<page>.route.tsx`
renders `null`; the parent page reads the URL and opens the drawer (CLAUDE.md ›
Dialog vs Full Page). Folder file prefixes follow the strip-`$` kebab rule.
Evidence: `S:n` = `schema-routes.md` line n.

\* default value.

- **Count:** 102 routes — 36 pages and layouts, 61 URL-driven dialogs and 5
  redirects — so 97 island folders. Redirects (the org index, the two
  edit → show redirects, `/medical`, `/stock`) are declared in `routeTree.tsx`
  with a `beforeLoad` redirect and get no island, like the `/` resolver.
- **Rooms with tabs** use literal child folders (D24): the bare `/payments`,
  `/offerings` and `/users` URLs render their first tab (Payments ledger,
  Offerings, Team); `/medical` and `/stock` redirect (to `sales`, `items`).
  Shared tab chrome (toolbar, tab track, create menu) lives in each room's
  family `shared/` folder.
- **Patient file:** `patients/$patientId/` is the layout (file bar, rail,
  Activity column); its index redirects to `timeline` (D19, D26). A section's
  dialogs nest under that section's folder, so the section page stays behind
  them. Check-in and review drawers sit over `overview` (Clinical notes), as the
  schema has them. An unknown section renders the default section.
- **Invoices** (`invoices/`): the shared Invoice drawer is reachable from
  Payments, the patient file and Medical. The island renders its referrer behind
  the drawer from a validated `from` search param (an allow-list of room paths;
  default the Payments ledger; the list includes `/today`, `/patients` and the
  patient file, and `/medical/sales`), so a deep link always has a page behind it.
  The same `from` param keeps the referring page behind `/payments/receive`,
  `/appointments/create`, `/appointments/$appointmentId` and
  `/medical/sales/create` when they open from another room (AMBER A-P1), and an
  optional `from=<section>` keeps the patient-file section behind `edit/`,
  `check-ins/*` and `reviews/*`. The file layout carries `activity`
  (`patient-id.search.ts`).
- **Not URL-addressable** (`S:112`): ⌘K, All sections, the branch picker, hover
  cards, filters, dropdowns, the stock "Use" popover, the Browse catalog popover,
  delete confirms, toasts, and stacked child drawers (`S:116`).
- **Not found** (`S:115`): an unknown org slug → `/`; an unknown path in an org →
  role home + toast "Page not found"; an unknown record id in a dialog route →
  the parent page renders, the drawer doesn't open, toast "<Record> not found".
- **Landing room** (D25): role home — Pharmacist `/medical/sales`, Accountant
  `/payments`, Marketing `/leads`, everyone else `/today`.
- **Splash is not a route.** It is the boot surface: `index.html#app-splash`,
  `src/lib/app-splash.ts` and `BrandLoader`. `BOOT_PENDING_POLICY` holds it
  until the first navigation resolves.
- **Settings** stays the `#settings/*` hash modal; its Members and Roles
  sections link into `/users` and `/users/roles` (D17).
- **Registrations per island:**
  - `routeTree.tsx` and `docs/reference/routes-and-ui.md`;
  - a builder in `src/lib/routes/builders.ts`;
  - param parsers in `src/lib/routes/params.ts` (ids);
  - search schemas in `<page>.search.ts` (the Query / notes column);
  - test ids in `docs/reference/e2e-testids-inventory.md`;
  - the i18n namespace wiring (§3.8).
- **Doc fix:** `docs/reference/routing-and-tenancy.md:38–40` sketches
  appointment detail under `patients/$patientId/appointments/$appointmentId`.
  That can't hold appointments for leads, so it gets updated to
  `/appointments/$appointmentId` (L-13).
- Skills: `fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island` (and `fe-resource-crud` for
  the dialog routes), with `fe-routing-tenancy` for guards and `fe-e2e-testids`
  for test ids.

## 5. State management map

Never violated:

- **TanStack Query owns every record** and the user's preferences
  (`usePreferences`, D32). Zustand holds only device prefs (`useDevicePrefsStore`)
  and ephemeral UI (`useUIStore`).
- **Filters:** pending-until-Apply sections are component state; applied
  filters live in the URL.
- **Drawers are URLs** (D24): which record is open, and in create or edit mode,
  is the route; the drawer's draft is form state. Stacked child drawers, the
  lead drawer's phone pane (Details · Chat) and the patient file's Activity
  toggle are component or search state, never a store.
- **Viewport is not state:** Tailwind tiers lay out phone / tablet / desktop
  (D23); `useViewportTier()` covers the few JS branches (§3.5).
- **Derived business values are pure functions in the domain module,**
  unit-tested and never stored: dues, effective price (`ofEff`), invoice totals
  (`pyTot`), hold/claim state, offer state, stock level and runway, week load
  bars, conflict checks, the phone row's key column and fold (H:4112, H:4125).
  One money module serves the invoice drawer, print and ledger.

| Screen       | Server state (Query)                                                                                                                                 | Client state                                                                                                                         | URL state                                                                                                                                           | Forms (RHF + Zod)                                                                                                                |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
