## 6. Per-screen build notes

Every block is built by **`fe-design-ditto`**. A typical island also uses:

- `fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island`;
- `shadcn`;
- `fe-http-forms-errors` (forms);
- `fe-i18n-constants`;
- `fe-e2e-testids`;
- `fe-test-generation`;
- `fe-visual-regression`, after fidelity sign-off.

Extra skills are named per block. Copy is verbatim from the cited prototype
lines and becomes keys in the screen's namespace (§3.8).

**Per screen, build in this order** (`fe-design-ditto` Step 4): interaction shell
(sheet, dialog or popover, with its mobile variant) → flow skeleton, conditional
steps included → regions at phone, tablet and desktop together (D16, D23) →
content (fields, copy, icons) → states → motion.

**Pacing:** one screen at a time. After each, show the side-by-side comparison
and wait for your OK before starting the next (`kickoff-iteration-prompt.md`, Pacing).

### 6.0 Shared behaviour (all rooms)

Built once with the §3.5 primitives by `fe-design-ditto`, with `shadcn`,
`fe-resilient-interactions` (single-flight writes, Undo), `fe-http-forms-errors` (write
errors), `fe-locale-formatting`, `fe-i18n-constants`, `fe-e2e-testids` and
`fe-test-generation`.

**Tiers** (D23; `_patterns.md:3–8`; `shell.md:71–76`). Phone < `md` (768px) · tablet
`md`–`xl` (768–1279px) · desktop ≥ `xl` (1280px); base classes are the phone, `md:` the
tablet, `xl:` the desktop. Compact spacing (< 1440px wide or < 800px tall, so every
tablet) is the §3.1 rule; the phone set replaces both (§3.5). The prototype's 760 /
1100 boundaries (H:2993) are Standing deviations: 760–767px renders the phone here,
1100–1279px the tablet (h1 18px, row actions ≥ 36×36).

**What changes by tier, in every room:**

| Behaviour                                     | Desktop ≥ `xl`                                 | Tablet `md`–`xl`                                           | Phone < `md`                                                                                          | Evidence             |
| --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Navigation                                    | header tabs + "More"                           | same; default pins fold to current + "More" at 820 / 1024  | `MobileNav` tab bar + All sections sheet (D30)                                                        | `shell.md:71–75`     |
| Page h1                                       | 20px                                           | 18px                                                       | `sr-only`; the header chip names the room                                                             | H:45, H:148          |
| Gutter, toolbar, table sides                  | comfortable at ≥ 1440 × 800, else compact      | compact                                                    | phone set: gutter 0, toolbar 8px 12px, sides 14px                                                     | `_patterns.md:10–21` |
| Toolbar tabs                                  | segmented; Medical / Payments fold into "More" | min 120px, grow, scroll sideways                           | own 36px row, scroll sideways                                                                         | H:142, H:54, H:93    |
| Primary "New"                                 | in the toolbar                                 | in the toolbar                                             | floating 52px pill above the tab bar                                                                  | H:55–61              |
| Tables                                        | fold into the meta line; "Show all"            | same; row actions ≥ 36×36                                  | rows wrap: primary + key column + ≤ 4 meta + actions line; no header, footer, selection or bulk (D31) | H:63–75, H:141       |
| Drawers                                       | `min(W, 100vw − 56px)`, floating × outside     | same                                                       | full screen, × inside 44px, 60px header, wrapping 44px footer                                         | H:26–38              |
| Pickers, Filters, All sections, file sections | popovers                                       | popovers                                                   | bottom sheets 72% (dim) / 82% / 85vh                                                                  | H:39–44, H:139–140   |
| Delete confirm                                | end panel 480px                                | same                                                       | bottom sheet (§7.2)                                                                                   | H:2688               |
| Tooltips                                      | 160ms hover                                    | hover, or tap for 1,400ms on touch                         | never                                                                                                 | H:94, H:4471         |
| Touch                                         | —                                              | `(hover: none)`: row actions and checkboxes always visible | same                                                                                                  | H:221                |

**Motion** (`_patterns.md:327–354`; prototype keyframes H:18, H:213, H:252–254, H:294).
The md's "ease" loses to these curves (D1):

| Element                                                  | Duration and easing                                                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Popover, dropdown, hover card (`czddin`)                 | 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1): opacity 0 → 1, translateY(−4px) scale(.985) → none                                                                     |
| Popover opening upward (`czddup`)                        | 160ms, same curve, translateY(4px)                                                                                                                     |
| Phone bottom sheet (`czsheet`)                           | 260ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1): translateY(28px) + opacity 0 → none                                                                                   |
| Drawer panel (`czdrawer`) and backdrop (`czbd`)          | 340ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); panel translateX(100%) → 0 (mirrored under RTL)                                                                       |
| Lead drawer panes                                        | transform 340ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)                                                                                                              |
| Floating × (`czpop`)                                     | 200ms after a 200ms delay, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity 0 + scale(.9) → none                                                                      |
| Command menu backdrop, photo viewer (`czfade`)           | 150ms ease                                                                                                                                             |
| Step body (`czacc`)                                      | 240ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity + translateY(−4px)                                                                                             |
| Bulk bar (`czbulk`)                                      | 220ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), translateY(100%) → none                                                                                               |
| List search expand                                       | 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) on flex-basis, max-width, min-width; background 120ms                                                                   |
| Header tabs, tab-bar pill                                | 160ms ease on background, color, box-shadow                                                                                                            |
| Segmented tabs                                           | 150ms ease                                                                                                                                             |
| Chevrons                                                 | rotate 180°, 150ms ease                                                                                                                                |
| Tooltip                                                  | 120ms ease, opacity + 2px rise, after a 160ms delay                                                                                                    |
| Row checkbox reveal, sort header, row hover              | 120ms ease                                                                                                                                             |
| Chat composer tint                                       | 200ms ease on background and border colour                                                                                                             |
| Skeleton shimmer (`czsk`) · dropdown skeleton (`czddsk`) | 1.1s · 1.2s in the specs, but invisible in the prototype (flat fill, H:269) — not built (§3.1)                                                         |
| Spinner (`czspin`)                                       | 700ms linear, infinite                                                                                                                                 |
| Upload progress                                          | width 150ms ease                                                                                                                                       |
| Reduced motion                                           | the platform rule (`src/index.css:1019`: durations .01ms, one iteration), plus delays 0 (H:15; H:379); shimmer and spinners stop; smooth scrolling off |

**Timers to keep** (real, not simulation):

- list search debounce 300ms; picker search 250ms (dynamic) / 300ms (remote); ⌘K
  search 250ms (the schema's `commandSearch`, S:1565);
- picker paging: within 64px of the end, or arrowing into the last 3 rows;
- double-click guard 450ms on every button — toggles, tabs, ×, steppers and menu
  triggers excepted (`_patterns.md:274`; H:2289). Writes are single-flight through
  `useAppMutation`, which is the guard for every submit;
- tooltip 160ms show, 1,400ms on a touch tap, hidden 60ms after a click;
- contact card 280ms open / 220ms close; team card 160 / 200ms;
- toasts 5,200ms, failures 9,000ms, Undo toasts 10,000ms (D32);
- a finished upload row leaves after 1,400ms;
- window resize re-measure 120ms (H:4522); header fold re-measured on resize and
  after `document.fonts.ready` (H:4083);
- print 260ms → rAF → `window.print()`.

**Simulation, never shipped** (D15): page loads 260–560ms and section switches
200–440ms, +280–600ms on 10% of loads; table refresh 160–380ms; drawer open 200–440ms;
save 320–740ms with 10% failures; list failures 5%; contact-card load 650ms; team card
220–480ms; remote picker latency 450ms; picker paging 380ms; infinite scroll 700ms;
message delivery 1,000ms (`_patterns.md:282–291`, `_patterns.md:158`). Every state they
exercise is still built and tested with real requests.

**Keyboard** (`shell.md:46`; `_patterns.md:271–274`; H:3165, H:4510–4512):

- "/" focuses the visible list search; ⌘K / Ctrl K toggles the command menu.
- G opens and closes All sections; 1–9 then 0 open the 1st–10th room of the role's
  visible list. Single-key shortcuts fire only outside text fields and without
  modifiers. All are listed in `KeyboardShortcutsDialog` (extended).
- **Esc** closes the top-most surface first: command menu → open dropdown → table
  selection → stacked child drawer → drawer → other popovers (`_patterns.md:271`). Every
  surface is in the chain — the prototype's gaps (Filters in Appointments, the contact
  editor, the branch, offer and stacked drawers, Day close, Stock check, the Use popover,
  "What’s next", Rules; H:4512) are fixed (D33). Radix layers give the order; the delete
  confirm treats Esc as "Keep it".
- **j / k** + ↵ move and open rows in the Leads list only (`_patterns.md:273`; Q-P3
  closed).
- Tablists move with the arrow keys; the picker keys are in §3.5.

**Inputs and touch:**

- The first letter of name-like inputs is capitalised as typed (H:4515–4521). Exempt:
  message textareas; `inputmode` tel, email, numeric or decimal; labels or placeholders
  naming Instagram, mobile, phone, email, "@", "+91", handle, search or jump; values
  starting with "@". Applied by the drawer's text-field unit (opt-out prop), not a
  document-level listener.
- Disabled controls sit at 50% opacity.
- Touch targets: tablet row actions ≥ 36×36 (H:141); phone row actions ≥ 40×36 (H:72),
  drawer footer buttons 44px (H:38), drawer × 44×44 (H:27), toolbar search and Filters
  40px (H:46, H:52), floating "New" 52px. The PRD's 44px tablet targets (`PRD.md:223`)
  lose to the prototype's 36px (D21; B.13).
- On touch screens row actions and checkboxes are always visible (H:221) and person
  cards open on tap (§3.5).

**States** (`_patterns.md:278–291`, the schema's write contract S:1544, not-found S:115;
per-room copy from each room's spec):

| State                                | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Page or section load                 | content replaced in place by skeleton bars (§3.5); clicks off                                                                                                                                                |
| Table refresh (search, sort, filter) | bars inside the rows; the header stays                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Drawer open                          | bars in the top-most drawer's scroll area                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Empty                                | `EmptyState` with the room's copy                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Filtered empty                       | "No matches" · "Nothing matches these filters. Clear them to see everything again." · "Clear filters"                                                                                                        |
| List error                           | toast "Couldn’t load this list · connection dropped. Showing the last copy." + "Retry" (9,000ms); the last rows stay                                                                                         |
| Save, network                        | the drawer stays open with the draft; footer "Not saved · your changes are kept"; button "Retry save"; toast "Couldn’t save · connection dropped. Everything you entered is still here." + "Retry" (9,000ms) |
| Save, validation                     | the drawer stays open, the field is outlined with its message, the step with the first missing field opens, and a toast names it (the prototype validates only after "Saving…", H:4461–4463)                 |
| Save, conflict                       | toast + the draft is kept (S:1544)                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Save, permission                     | toast "You don't have access to do this" (S:1544)                                                                                                                                                            |
| Not found                            | unknown path in an org → role home + toast "Page not found"; unknown record in a dialog route → the parent page, no drawer, toast "<Record> not found · it may have been deleted" (S:115)                    |
| Dropdown                             | 4 skeleton rows + spinner; "Nothing to pick yet"; "No results for “<query>”" + "Try a name, phone number or ID" / "Check the spelling or try fewer letters"                                                  |
| Command menu                         | "No matches. Try a name, phone or #ID."                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Chat column                          | the host's bars; "No conversation yet" card; failed message "Not sent" + "Retry"; outage "WhatsApp down · replies will queue", messages "Queued"                                                             |
| Hover cards                          | hidden until loaded; contact without reach: "No phone or handle saved yet"; a failed load simply doesn't open                                                                                                |
| Upload tray                          | "Uploading <left> of <total>…"; over the limit "<n> file(s) over 10 MB skipped"                                                                                                                              |
| Permission-limited                   | create buttons hidden, row actions filtered, drawers read-only ("View only · your role can’t change this")                                                                                                   |

**Command menu** — extend the existing `CommandPalette` (moved onto `ui/command`, §3.5);
it respects access and the View-as preview (`_patterns.md:195–207`; H:4598–4611).

- **Panel:** centred `dialog` aria-label "Command menu", 12vh from the top, over
  `bg-overlay/35` (`czfade` 150ms); `min(640px, 100% − 32px)` × max `min(560px, 76vh)`,
  `rounded-xl`, shadow 0 24px 64px /.22, `czddin` 160ms. The header is a 52px input row:
  `Search` 15px · input 15px, placeholder "Search or jump to…", aria-label "Search",
  focused on open · kbd "esc". Results `role="listbox"`, padding 6px; group headers
  11px/600 uppercase; rows 40px `rounded-lg`: 15px icon · title 13.5px/500 · sub at the
  inline end 12px (max 45%); the active row `bg-muted`. Footer 36px, `bg-canvas`,
  11.5px: kbd "↑" kbd "↓" "move" · kbd "↵" "open" · at the end "Type 2+ letters to
  search patients, leads and invoices" until 2 letters.
- **Phone:** the same centred dialog, full width minus 32px (358px at 390), ≤ 76vh —
  as the platform palette already renders.
- **Groups and limits:**
  - "Actions" (always, max 5): "New lead" (Leads) → `/leads/create`; "New appointment"
    (Appointments) → `/appointments/create`; "New patient" (Patients) →
    `/patients/create`; "New receipt" (Payments) → `/payments/receive`; "Open tasks"
    (Tasks) → `/tasks`. The prototype only switches rooms for New appointment and New
    receipt (H:4600); here each opens its form route (D24; Q-A15).
  - "Go to" (once typing; sub "Screen"; max 4): the role's visible rooms from the
    prototype's list — Leads, Appointments, Patients, Medical, Stock, Payments, Tasks,
    Offerings, Users (H:4602). Access-filtered (the prototype ignores access,
    H:4600–4603).
  - "Patients" (from 2 letters; name, 3+ phone digits or #ID; sub "#<id> · •••• <last 4
    digits>"; max 6) → `/patients/$patientId` (the default section, D19 / D26), with
    Activity open on tablet and desktop and closed on phone (H:4605).
  - "Leads" (sub "#<id> · <status>"; max 5; contact threads excluded, H:4606) →
    `/leads/$leadId`.
  - "Invoices" (title "<type> invoice #<id>", sub "<patient> · <date>"; max 4) →
    `/invoices/$invoiceId` (the prototype only switches to Payments, H:4607).
  - Search runs on the schema's `commandSearch` (q ≥ 2, 10 per type, S:1565); the UI
    keeps the prototype's per-group caps and shows no Appointments group.
- **Keys:** ↑↓ wrap · ↵ opens · Esc closes · ⌘K toggles; a backdrop click or tap closes.

**Contact card** (hover or tap on any person; `_patterns.md:209–219`):

- **Header** (tinted: patient `tone-sage-tint`, lead `tone-lav-tint`, else
  `bg-canvas`; padding 14px 12px 14px 14px): 48px avatar (16px "P" for patients) ·
  name 15px/600, a link to the patient file with "↗" when a patient exists (title "Open
  patient file") · patient ID in tone ink 600 + "Since <date>" or "Lead since <date>"
  11.5px · pills "Patient" / "Lead" / "Contact" + up to 2 tags · 28px "Edit contact"
  (`PenLine` 13px) and, inside forms only, "Change contact" (`RefreshCw` 13px, title "Pick
  a different contact").
- **Reach:** one 32px-tile row per number or handle (WhatsApp mark on sage, `Phone` on
  sky, Instagram mark on blush): value 13px/600 + sub ("WhatsApp · primary", "Phone ·
  alternate", "Instagram") + 28px links (WhatsApp, Call, "Open Instagram") + "Copy"
  (`Copy`; toast "Copied <value>"); none: "No phone or handle saved yet".
- **Team:** 28px chips, with "Open · Claim" when an open lead can be claimed.
- **About** (14px icons): `Users` "Female · 32 yrs" · `MessageSquare` language ·
  `MapPin` area · `House` household · `Tag` "Came via <source>" · `Wallet` "<₹> to
  return to them · <₹> they owe the clinic" · `Sparkles` "<N> reviews · latest 5★ on
  Google · 20 Sep" · `Shield` consent pills "✓ Data" / "✕ Photos" / "✓ Marketing" (sage
  when given, `bg-muted` when not; tooltip "Consent · Data").
- **Footer** (`bg-canvas`, hairline, padding 10px 14px 12px; equal grid of 32px
  outline buttons): "+ Lead" (title "New enquiry for this contact") →
  `/leads/create?name=&phone=`; "+ Appointment" ("Book for this contact") →
  `/appointments/create?who=`; "+ Patient" ("Create a patient record for this
  contact"; only when not a patient) creates directly with the toast "Patient record
  created for <name> · contact updated" (H:5682).

  MedicalContact through the schema's `contactCard` (S:1566); "Edit contact" edits that
  record. The UI's extra reach rows, household, language, credits, review summary and
  the three consent chips (the schema has one `consentGiven`) are Appendix F.

**Team card** (hover or tap on a team member; `_patterns.md:221–229`; H:6130–6151):

- **Header** (padding 14px): 48px avatar in the member's tone + 12px status dot (online
  `presence-online`, offline `border-strong`) · name 15px/600 · role 12px · "Online
  now" / "Offline" 11.5px with a 6px dot · a 22px kind pill at the inline end:
  "Assigned" (dark), "Sent this" (sage), "Treating", others `bg-muted`.
- **Body:** an optional 36px dark button — "Assign to yourself", or the caller's label
  "Claim <first>" / "Join · take <first>" / "Take over from <first>"; "Reach" (11px/600
  uppercase): `Phone`, `Mail`, `House` (branches, e.g. "Adajan · Vesu"), `Clock` ("Works
  10:00 – 19:00"), 13px icons, 12.5px `foreground-soft`.
- **Footer:** `bg-canvas`, hairline, 11px: "Updated HH:MM" ("Fetching latest…"
  while loading).
- Presence comes from the schema's presence (S:1571); hours and branches from the staff
  profile (Appendix F).

### 6.1 Splash (boot)

- **Shape:** full-bleed boot layer, `role="status"`, aria-label "Loading Clinozy";
  one column centred on both axes, gap 22px; the app renders underneath at opacity 0
  (`splash.md:17`; H:516, H:522). It **restyles** the existing `#app-splash`
  (`index.html`) and keeps its hold-based exit (`src/lib/app-splash.ts`,
  `BOOT_PENDING_POLICY`); it is not a new splash and not a route (§4). The mark is
  the L-59 brand mark.
- **Regions** (`splash.md:17–22`; H:516–520), tokens per §3.1 / Appendix E:

  | Region                 | Build                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
  | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | Layer                  | fixed, inset 0, `card` canvas (prototype `--z0`; dark `#141417`), overflow hidden                                                                                                                                                                       |
  | Mark                   | 64px SVG on a 28-unit grid: rx 8 square in `primary`, "C" stroke 2.6 round caps (path length 40) in `primary-foreground`, dot r 2.3 at 20.2/14 in `brand-mark`; halo inset −10px (84px), `rounded-3xl` (24px), `brand-mark` at 18%. Both `aria-hidden`  |
  | Wordmark               | "clin" + ring + "zy", 34px/600, −0.03em, line-height 1, `foreground`, no wrap; the "o" is a 0.56em SVG (ring r 7.6, stroke 4.2, centre dot r 3 in `--k4`, Appendix E). Brand drawing, not a translated string; `aria-hidden`                            |
  | Greeting block         | margin-top 2px, column gap 10px: greeting 15px/500 `primary`, no wrap                                                                                                                                                                                   |
  | Progress (online only) | bar 180 × 2px, `rounded-full`, track `muted-strong` (`#efeff1`), fill `primary` from the inline start; ticker window 18px, three 18px lines: 6px dot + 12.5px `muted-foreground`, gap 6px                                                               |
  | Offline notice         | `role="alert"` column, gap 10px: "Can’t reach Clinozy · check the internet connection" 12.5px `muted-foreground-strong`, no wrap · "Retry" 36px, padding 0 14px, 1px `border`, `rounded-lg`, `card` fill, 13px/500, hover `muted` → `location.reload()` |

- **Frames** (`splash.md:47–49, 65–76`; H:517–520, H:4504) — CSS keyframes in
  `index.html`, so the mark draws before any JS:

  | Frame          | Property                                                          | Duration and easing                   | Start        |
  | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------ |
  | Mark           | opacity 0→1, scale .6→1                                           | 700ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.05)`  | 50ms         |
  | Halo           | 0%: opacity 0, scale .7 · 40%: 1 · 100%: 0, scale 1.25            | 1,400ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`    | 550ms        |
  | "C" stroke     | dashoffset 40→0                                                   | 700ms `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`     | 550ms        |
  | Dot            | scale 0 → 1.25 (60%) → 1                                          | 500ms `cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1)`   | 1,150ms      |
  | Wordmark       | opacity, translateY 8px→0, blur 6px→0                             | 800ms `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`      | 1,250ms      |
  | Greeting block | opacity, translateY 6px→0                                         | 500ms ease                            | 1,900ms      |
  | Bar            | scaleX 0→1 from the inline start                                  | 1,500ms `cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`     | 2,050ms      |
  | Ticker         | translateY 0 → −18px (2,500–2,650ms) → −36px (3,040–3,190ms)      | `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)` per slide | 2,050ms      |
  | Exit           | splash opacity 1→0 (pointer-events off at once) · app opacity 0→1 | 500ms ease · 450ms ease               | exit         |
  | Removal        | layer removed                                                     | —                                     | exit + 520ms |

- **Ticker copy** (`splash.md:95–97`; H:4151): "Opening <Weekday>’s schedule"
  (full weekday, curly ’, dot `border-strong`) → "Syncing patients and leads" (dot
  `border-strong`) → "All set" (dot `success`). The weekday is formatted in the
  clinic's timezone (`Organization.timezone`, S:148) through `useLocaleFormat`
  (`fe-locale-formatting`).
- **Greeting** (`splash.md:94`; H:4151): "Good morning, <first name>" before 12:00 ·
  "Good afternoon, …" 12:00–16:59 · "Good evening, …" from 17:00, on the real
  clinic-local clock (D15), no clamp. The name is the signed-in user's
  `firstName` (S:192, "Dr." kept, S:209) — never the prototype's role demo name
  (H:4151, `ROLES[].me`). One pure `greetingFor(hour)` helper serves the splash and
  Today (§6.2).
- **When the greeting block plays:** the greeting, bar and ticker need i18n and the
  session, so they render from a small React slot into `#app-splash` once both are
  ready; the HTML carries no copy (Q-S1). They play on the first load of the org
  layout (S:20 "Splash plays on first load of this layout"); other boots (`/login`,
  onboarding) show frames 1–4 only. If the session resolves after 1,900ms the block
  fades in when ready (AMBER).
- **Exit (Q-S1, D25):** the existing hold mechanism decides it — the splash leaves
  when boot resolves, never before the wordmark lands (2,050ms), not on the
  prototype's fixed 3,700ms timer (H:4504, D15). It cross-fades onto the booted
  route; a bare org URL resolves to the **role home** (Pharmacist `/medical/sales`,
  Accountant `/payments`, Marketing `/leads`, everyone else `/today`; S:20, S:114,
  D25) — never Leads (`splash.md:6`; H:4494 `startRoom ?? 'leads'`, demo state).
  `EXIT_FALLBACK_MS` and the `#app-splash` transition move from 360 / 200ms to
  520 / 500ms ease (kept in step, as the file's comment requires); `#root` gets the
  450ms ease entrance.
- **Offline** (`splash.md:22, 46, 84`; H:13, H:520): decided by
  `navigator.onLine === false` at mount, re-read on render. Frames 1–5 play; the
  progress block is **hidden** (`data-spl-prog="true"` → `display:none`, H:13); the
  offline notice shows under the greeting; no exit runs and the 8,000ms
  `MAX_HOLD_MS` hand-off is suspended — only "Retry" (reload) leaves (AMBER). A
  first visit with no cached shell can't load the JS and shows the browser's own
  error (out of scope).
- **Reduced motion** (`splash.md:46, 78`; H:4504): every frame 1ms with no delay —
  mark, wordmark, greeting, full bar and "All set" at once; exit from 500ms, layer
  removed at 580ms.
- **Viewports** (`splash.md:9, 17, 22`; no rule in H:17–191): phone and tablet are
  the desktop column — at 390 × 844 the mark's top sits at y≈322 and the block is
  ≈182px wide; the 298px offline line fits at 375 with ≈38px each side. No
  breakpoint classes; verified at 375, 820, 1024 and 1440 (D10).
- **Copy:** "Loading Clinozy" (the HTML aria-label, English until the slot mounts
  and swaps in the key), greeting, ticker, offline message, "Retry" — keys in the
  entry-resident `common` namespace so the offline line never waits on a lazy
  namespace (Q-S1).
- **Tests:** `src/lib/app-splash.test.ts` (520ms fallback, offline hold, reduced
  motion, no exit before 2,050ms); `tests/e2e/boot-splash.e2e.test.ts` (status
  label, offline alert + Retry via `context.setOffline(true)`, reduced motion via
  `emulateMedia`, lands on the role home).
- **Skills:** `fe-design-ditto`, `frontend-design` (keyframes), `fe-pwa-manifest`
  (the mark, with L-59), `fe-locale-formatting`, `fe-i18n-constants`,
  `fe-test-generation`, `fe-playwright-e2e`, `fe-bundle-performance` (the slot
  stays off the entry chunk).

### 6.3 Leads (`leads/`, `leads/create/`, `leads/$leadId/`)

**Routes** (§4, D24; `S:22–25`):

- `leads/` is the page. `leads/create/` (New lead) and `leads/$leadId/` (the
  lead drawer — show **is** edit, `S:24`; files `lead-id.route.tsx`,
  `LEAD_ID.OVERVIEW.md`) are URL-driven dialogs over it whose route files render
  `null`; `/leads/$leadId/edit` is a `routeTree.tsx` redirect to
  `/leads/$leadId` with no island (`S:25`).
- `leads.search.ts`: `view=mine*|unread|all`, `q`, `status` (one value — tap
  again clears, `leads.md:180`; the contract accepts many, `S:1588`), `source`
  (many), `hold=any*|open|soon|held`, `owner` (many ids, matched as assigned
  **or** involved, H:5636), `created`, `followUp`, `sort`
  (`name|status|source|updated`, ± direction). `view`, `hold`, the involved
  match and the `updated` sort are backend requests (Appendix F). The schema's
  `interest` filter has no designed control and is not offered.
- `leads/create/` reads the schema prefill `?name=&phone=` (`S:23`; ⌘K "New
  lead", contact card "+ Lead"). A phone number in a URL reaches history,
  PostHog pageviews and Sentry breadcrumbs, so `name` and `phone` join
  `SENSITIVE_QUERY_PARAMS` in `src/lib/telemetry-scrub.ts:15`, which both
  telemetry paths already run (§7.2; AMBER A-L1).
- Unknown `$leadId`, or the id of a contact thread → `/leads` renders, no
  drawer, toast "Lead not found · it may have been deleted" (`S:115`).
  Contact threads (`kind = contact_thread`) never appear in a list, count or
  filter (`leads.md:42`, `S:261`).
- Section tone lav (`leads.md:11`); icon `UserPlus` 16. Entry points: header
  tab, phone tab bar, ⌘K, contact card "+ Lead", the appointment form's
  "Connected lead" chip (→ `/leads/$leadId`), a person with no patient record
  (`leads.md:5`). Role home for Marketing (D25).

  rows at the measured row height (53px default) with 10 rows of overscan
  (H:4157) — Leads' threshold, not the table default.
- The 40px footer strip under the rows never holds text (H:1749, `ldShown`
  is `''` at H:6153) — dropped, per Q-A11 extended to Leads (AMBER A-L2).
- **Tablet:** all six columns; at 820px the 830px row scrolls inside the card,
  at 1024px it fits (`leads.md:18, 39`).
- **Phone (below `md`):** rows, not cards. The card goes edge to edge (no
  radius, side borders or shadow, H:63); header hidden (H:64); each row is a
  wrapping flex line — gap 6px 12px, padding 12px 14px 12px 11px, the 3px edge
  kept — flowing person → Status → Source → Interested in → Team → Updated, no
  meta-line fold (H:65, `leads.md:39`). Tooltips never show (H:94); contact and
  team cards open on tap (`_patterns.md:214, 226`).

**Views** (`leads.md:42`): Mine (default; owner is me) · Unreplied (owner is
me and unread; count chip) · All. Server queries (`listLeads`, `S:1588`) —
`ownerId = me` and an `unread` flag plus a count are backend requests (the
contract has no totals, C31).

**Filters** — the shared popover (§3.5), 340px, max height `100vh − 140px`,
padding 12px; inline-end aligned 6px below, shifting or flipping to stay in
view (`leads.md:166–180`, H:1698):

- Header "Filters" 13.5/600 · "Clear all". Sections: "Status" (one of the
  eight; tap again to clear) · "Source · pick any" (with icons, "Clear") ·
  "Ownership · hold after idle days" (Any · Open to claim · Releasing today ·
  Held) · "Team · assigned or involved" (picker "Anyone on the team" /
  "<name>" / "<n> people" expanding an inline list with "Search team", 28px
  avatars, 24px checkboxes, "No match", "Clear") · "Created" (Any · Today ·
  Yesterday · Last 7 days · Last 30 days · This month · Custom range) ·
  "Follow-up date" (Any · Overdue · Today · Tomorrow · Next 7 days · Not set ·
  Custom range); "Custom range" adds "From" and "To" pickers.
- Pending until the sticky "Apply filter" (32px); then the URL updates and the
  rows refetch with their text as shimmer bars (1,100ms loop) and clicks
  blocked until the page lands. Dismiss: outside click, Esc, Apply.
- "Releasing today" matches left ≤ 1 day, which is tomorrow (H:5621, H:5636) —
  fixed to the real buckets (§7.3). Created and Follow-up read `createdAt` and
  `followUpAt`; the prototype hashes them (H:3856).
- **Phone:** bottom sheet — full width, max 82%, top `rounded-2xl`, no dim,
  260ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)` from 28px below (H:41,
  `leads.md:171`).

**Lead drawer** (`leads/$leadId/`, `leads.md:20, 124–136`, H:1752–1867):

- **Desktop and tablet (`md` and up):** two fixed panels at the inline end,
  full height — details (inline start) and chat (inline end). Total
  `round(min(980, 0.94 × vw))`; chat `max(360, min(pref ‖ 420, total − 400))`;
  details the rest (H:4572, H:6126) — 560 + 420 at 1440, 543 + 420 at 1024,
  400 + 371 at 820. Backdrop `bg-overlay/28` appears at once (no fade); the
  panes slide in together from `translate3d(total + 40px, 0, 0)` in 340ms
  `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)` and hide 340ms after closing; the 36px × floats
  12px outside the details pane's inline-start edge, top 14px (H:1752).
  Pure function `leadDrawerWidths(vw, pref)`, unit-tested.
- **Phone (below `md`; Q-L1 now designed, `leads.md:20, 129, 300–308`):**
  full screen. A fixed 52px bar (`bg-card`, bottom hairline): 36px back button
  "Close lead" (`ChevronLeft` 16, H:3038) and a segmented `role="tablist"`
  "Lead panels" — "Details" (`Users` 14) · "Chat" (`WhatsAppMark` 14), 30px
  segments, 13px/500 (H:1753). One pane at a time, starting under the bar
  (top 52px); Chat is the default and the choice persists between leads
  (component state of the Leads page). The floating × is not rendered. The
  "Chat" segment shows an 18px `bg-success` count while Details is showing —
  the prototype reads the lead's unread count, which opening the lead has just
  cleared, so it almost never shows (H:6126, H:5643); built: messages that
  arrive while Details is showing (§7.3).
- **Modality:** the prototype is not a dialog (no `aria-modal`, H:1752–1754).
  Built as a modal `sheet` (`role="dialog"`, focus trapped and returned, the
  details heading focused; the composer is not focused, `leads.md:136`) —
  §7.3. Stacking: backdrop < panes < × < phone bar (H:1752–1754).
- **Dismiss:** backdrop, Esc (after any open popover), ×, phone "Close lead".
  Closing with an unsaved draft asks "Discard changes?" (Q-P1; the prototype
  keeps the draft until a row is reopened, `leads.md:73`).
- **Chat resize** (`leads.md:131`): a 7px `role="separator"` on the chat's
  inline-start edge, tooltip "Drag to resize · double-click to reset"; drag
  360–680px; ← / → step 20px; double-click resets to 420. The prototype's keys
  clamp 300–640 from a 380 base and its ARIA says 340–720 (H:1829,
  H:6122–6123) — one clamp, 360–680, for drag, keys and ARIA; arrows follow
  the reading direction under RTL (§7.3). Width persists as
  `useDevicePrefsStore.leadChatWidth` (§3.3). shadcn `resizable` if its
  constraints take pixel clamps, else a small separator unit (AMBER A-L3).
- **Details header** (76px; 60px phone; `leads.md:133`): h2 "Edit lead"
  20/600 · ID button "#<seq>" (mono 12px, 32px, copy icon fading in over 150ms
  on hover, tooltip "Lead #<seq> · created <created> · click to copy", toast
  "Lead ID #<seq> copied") · "Re-target" pill (`RefreshCw`, tooltip = the
  re-target reason) on re-target leads; sub "Make your changes, then Save
  lead" 12.5px muted (H:1754).
- **Cards** — three, stacked and always open (not an accordion); circle
  green when filled (Lead details: a source and an interest; Progress: always),
  else dark (`leads.md:266–271`):
  1. **"Lead details"** (H:1768):
     - Source — single chips Instagram · Google · WhatsApp · Facebook ·
       Walk-in · Referral · Re-target with icons, selected = 1px ring in its
       tone; plus "Phone call" (`Phone`, sky), which the New lead preset sets
       but the chip list lacks (H:6159 vs H:3348; Q-L6, AMBER A-L4).
     - Interested in — chips Clinical · Peel · LHR · Hydrafacial · PRP plus
       custom ones (H:5722 drops "Others" from the chips); selected show
       `SquareCheck` 12; dashed 90px "Add interest" input: Enter or blur adds,
       Esc clears, ≤30 chars, case-insensitive dedupe (`leads.md:64`).
     - "Assigned & involved" — 36px full-width picker button ("+ Add
       involved" when nobody is involved); a dark 20px "Claim" pill when the
       lead is open to the team and not mine; "Release" (tooltip "Let anyone
       on the team take it") when it is mine and held. Applies at once — not
       part of the draft (`leads.md:65`).
  2. **"Progress"** (H:1809–1811, `leads.md:284`) — 4-tile track New ·
     Contacted · Follow-up · Clinic visited: done = tone ink fill, white text,
     white disc with an ink check, 3px bar 100%; current = tone tint, ringed
     dot with a 3px halo, bar 50%; next = 30% tint, dashed numbered circle,
     bar 0%; labels "Done" / "Current" / "Next"; tooltips "<status> ·
     completed" / "<status> · current step" / "Move to <status>". "Close as":
     No response · Not interested · Invalid · Lost. Any status to any (Q-L4).
     Drafted until Save.
  3. **"Info"** (H:1813) — read-only grid, cells min 150px: Created · Last
     message ("<Channel> · <at>" or "None yet") · Patient ("Linked" / "Not
     yet", with "Convert to patient" `UserPlus` 13 when not a patient and the
     status is Contacted or Follow-up) · Open tasks · Re-target reason (full
     width, re-target leads; `Lead.retargetReason`, `S:263`).
- **Footer** (`leads.md:70, 134`, H:1818–1821): "Remove lead" (36px,
  `destructive` — the prototype's raw `#dc2626`) at the inline start · "Not
  saved · your changes are kept" (6px dot, after a failed save) · "Discard"
  (outline, only while dirty) · "Save lead" (36px; disabled — `bg-border`, `text-disabled` — until dirty;
  "Saving…", "Retry save").
- **Save** (`updateLead`, `S:1594`): source, interests and status. Success:
  "Lead saved", or "<name> → <status>" + "Undo" when the status changed
  (Follow-up adds " · follow-up task for tomorrow"); the drawer stays open
  (H:5649). Undo reverts the status **and** its side effects — the prototype
  reverts only the status (H:5635, §7.3). Save, Remove and Convert are gated
  (§3.7).
- **Status side effects** — server rules, a fixture job now (Q-T3;
  `leads.md:275–283`, H:5633–5634, H:5653–5656):
  - Follow-up → a "Follow-up" task due tomorrow for me (outcomes "Reached" ·
    "No answer"); `followUpAt` is set to that due time (AMBER A-L5). The
    prototype hard-codes "<first> (you)" as owner (H:5634) — computed.
  - No response → a "Call back" task due tomorrow ("Status moved to No
    response. Follow up with the lead."), skipped while one is open; stored as
    task kind `follow_up` (`S:1502`; AMBER A-L5).
  - First WhatsApp or Instagram reply to a New or Re-targeted lead →
    Contacted, system pill "Status → Contacted (first reply)"; a call logged on
    a New lead → "Status → Contacted (call logged)".
  - An appointment saved Checked in or Completed → every open lead of that
    person → Clinic visited, "Status → Clinic visited · checked in for
    appointment #<seq>" (`S:1610`, H:6047).
  - "Convert to patient" → `createPatient` with `leadId` (a backend request:
    the schema has `Patient.leadId` and `Lead.patientId`, `S:260, 317`, but
    `createPatient` takes no lead, `S:1623`); status Clinic visited; toast
    "Patient record created for <name> · lead stays linked" + "Undo"; system
    line "Converted to patient". The prototype writes the literal "#3509"
    (H:5805) — the server id is used (§7.3).
- **"Re-targeted"** is shown for `status = new` with `kind = retarget`
  (`S:1066, 1100`); the contract stores no such status (D22).
- **Hold, claim and release** — pure function `leadHold(lead, holdDays, now)`,
  unit-tested (H:3869):
  - closed (Clinic visited, Not interested, Invalid, Lost, or linked to a
    patient) never releases; idle = days since the last touch, reset by owner
    activity (Q-L9); left = hold − idle; open when left ≤ 0 or the owner has
    left the clinic.
  - Pills: "Open · Claim" (open, not mine; tooltip "No activity for <n> days ·
    anyone can claim it"), "Open to team · Join" (owner left; "<name> has left
    the clinic · anyone on the team can join and take it"), "Open to team"
    (mine); the 7px dot when left = 1 ("Released to the team today if nobody
    follows up" / "… tomorrow if nobody follows up").
  - Claim: I become owner, the previous owner joins as involved; toast "You now
    own <name> · <owner> stays involved" + "Undo" (from the row) or "Claimed by
    <me> after <n> idle days · <owner> stays involved". Release: "Released to
    the team · anyone can claim" / "<name> is open for anyone to claim".
  - Hold days are an org setting, default 3 (H:4013); its "Auto-release
    after" control is never rendered (H:5738) and isn't built. None of this is
    in the contract (C17) — Appendix F.
- **"People on this lead"** popover (`leads.md:182–196`, H:1780, H:5663):
  anchored below the button (above when there is less room); width
  `clamp(320px, trigger, 440px)`; max height `min(460px, space)`, at least
  160px; phone: inside the pane, clamped 8px. Sticky 44px search "Search team",
  "Assigned to · who handles this lead now", rows: 30px avatar · name ·
  "<role> · <activity>" · "Assign" / "Assigned" (32px; disabled at 40% with
  "Only the assignee (<name>) can reassign" or "<my role> can’t assign to
  <role>") · 32px involved toggle "+" / "✓" (hover on ✓ shows a red ×); "No
  match"; footer "✓ Involved = everyone who worked on this lead. Added
  automatically when they reply, call, note or book · you can add someone too".
  Assign rules, pure `canAssign(myRole, theirRole, isOwner)` (H:5704): Front
  desk → Front desk, Counsellor; Counsellor → Front desk, Counsellor, Doctor;
  Doctor → Doctor, Therapist, Counsellor, Front desk; the prototype gives Admin,
  Owner and Marketing nothing — Admin and Owner assign anyone, Marketing as
  Front desk (AMBER A-L6). Events: system pill "Assigned to <name> ·
  <previous> stays involved", toast "<name> is now assigned · notified" +
  "Undo"; "Added <name> as involved" / "Removed <name> from involved".

**Chat column** — the shared `ChatColumn` (§3.5: thread, history pills,
bubbles, delivery labels, empty starters, composer, Suggestions, drafts), built
here as its first host and reused by the appointment form, the task drawer and
the patient file. What the lead drawer adds (`leads.md:44–55, 109–120,
214–228`, H:1828–1866):

- Opening a lead sets the composer mode to the channel of their last message,
  else the default channel (`leads.md:36`); sending on another channel makes it
  the lead's default (H:5654). Sends are `sendMessage` with channel
  `whatsapp` · `instagram` · `call` · `note` (`S:1595`).
- Mode labels follow the dragged width: shown only when
  `min(pref ‖ 420, max(300, round(0.34 × vw))) ≥ 460` (H:5770) — so icon-only
  at the 420 default and always on phone; pure `composerShowsLabels`.
- Message-driven status moves and auto-involve are the side effects above
  (Q-L9); the outage line stays hidden until the backend signals it (Q-L10).
- Starters, smart chips, templates and fill-ins are `leads.md:410–433`; the
  clinic name, address, maps and review links come from org / branch
  settings, never "Cresence Skin", "Shop 12, Silver Point, Vesu, Surat",
  "maps.app.goo.gl/cresence" or "g.page/r/cresence/review" (`leads.md:432`).
- **"Book an appointment"** (`Calendar` 15) opens the appointment form (§6.4)
  as a stacked child drawer over the lead drawer — the URL stays
  `/leads/$leadId` (`S:116`; AMBER A-L7): who = this lead; type Treatment
  with "LHR Treatment" when an interest matches `/lhr|laser/i`, else
  Consultation; 20 min; today; no time; step 1 collapsed and "Date & time"
  open; Reason = the first 80 characters of their last inbound message
  (H:5751). Wired in the appointment-form row.
- **Phone:** the column is the whole Chat pane under the 52px bar; the
  Suggestions popover stays inside it (`leads.md:55, 219`).

**New lead** (`leads/create/`, `leads.md:21, 75–90, 138–150, 246–262`,
H:1883–1961):

- **Shape:** right drawer `min(640px, 100vw − 56px)`, full height, modal,
  backdrop `bg-overlay/45` fading in 340ms, panel 340ms
  `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, floating 36px × 10px outside its inline-start
  edge (scale .9 → 1 over 200ms after a 200ms delay). Header 76px: h2 "New
  lead" 20/600, sub "Name and mobile are enough to start". **Phone:** full
  width; the prototype pushes the × off-screen and leaves only "Cancel"
  (H:1886, H:26–27) — built with the × inside the header, top 8px, 44×44
  (`_patterns.md:31`; D33, §7.3).
- **The sequence varies by input** (`leads.md:251–258`):

  | Input                           | Contact                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Lead details                                                                                                                                        |
  | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | No contact ("New lead", ⌘K)     | Step 1, open: 44px search (autofocus, aria "Search existing patient or contact", "Search by name or mobile"), results from 2 characters, max 5 — patients "Patient <ID> · last visit <date>" · "Re-create lead", contacts "<kind> · <mobile>" · "Use contact"; "No existing match"; "Quick start" chips (28px) Walk-in `House` · Phone call `Phone` · Instagram DM `InstagramMark`; 40px row "New contact" (`Plus`) → contact editor | Step 2, locked: grey number, hint "After contact", summary "Source, interest and who handles it"; tapping it toasts "Pick or add the contact first" |
  | Existing patient picked         | Contact card: 38px sage avatar + "P", name, mobile + " · +N more", "Change"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Step 1, open; source Re-target; linked to the patient; toast "Existing patient <ID> · new lead will be linked"                                      |
  | Existing contact picked         | Contact card, lav avatar                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Step 1, open; toast "Using existing contact <name>"                                                                                                 |
  | "New contact" saved with a name | Contact card                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Step 1, open                                                                                                                                        |
  | Contact card "+ Lead"           | Contact card, name and mobile known                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Step 1, open                                                                                                                                        |

  "Change" (on the card or in its hover card) clears the contact, resets the
  source to WhatsApp and returns to two steps. Quick start changes values, not
  steps: Walk-in → source Walk-in, status Clinic visited; Phone call → source
  Phone call, status Contacted; Instagram DM → Instagram, New; toast "<chip>
  preset applied"; without a preset the status is New (H:6159). Step circles
  24px — open dark, filled `success`, locked grey; no Next buttons
  (`leads.md:259–261`).

- **Lead details fields** (`leads.md:82–84`): Source (default WhatsApp; the
  drawer's chips) · Interested in (as the drawer) · Assigned & involved
  (default owner = me; anyone can be assigned here; the owner can't also be
  involved).
- **Footer:** "Creates or updates one contact" (inline start, 12.5px muted) ·
  "Cancel" (outline) · "Not saved · your changes are kept" (after a failure) ·
  "Create lead" (36px, primary, always enabled; "Saving…", "Retry save").
- **Validation** on submit, before saving (the prototype checks after its save
  delay, H:4461–4463): toast "Add a name and a 10-digit mobile"; server
  `validation` outlines the field (`S:1545`); a `conflict` (the phone is

  (`leads.md:89`). Status, `patientId` and the contact fields on create are

**Remove lead** — the shared reason confirm (§3.5; `leads.md:230–244`,
H:5814): title "Remove this lead?" (the prototype reads "Remove lead this
lead?", H:4449); grey pill with the lead's name; "The lead leaves every list
and the owner’s queue. Chat history is kept. You can undo from the toast right
after."; reasons Duplicate · Test entry · Spam · Other ("Tell the team why
(required)"); "Keep it" · "Remove lead" (destructive, disabled until valid).
Stored as the contract's `delete_reason` (`S:1490–1496`, B.13 R41): Duplicate
→ `duplicate`; Test entry and Spam → `other` with the label as `deleteNote`;
Other → `other` + the note (AMBER A-L9). Soft delete; the drawer closes;
toast "Lead #<seq> removed · <reason>" + "Undo" for 10s → `POST
/leads/:id/restore` (D32, `S:1546`).

**Motion** (`leads.md:350–369`):

| Element                                      | Duration and easing                                                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Lead drawer panes                            | 340ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, translate from total + 40px; hidden 340ms after close; backdrop none |
| New lead / contact editor panel and backdrop | 340ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`                                                                       |
| Floating ×                                   | 200ms after 200ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, scale .9 → 1                                             |
| Card body open                               | 240ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, −4px → 0                                                              |
| Filters, people popover, dropdowns           | 160ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, −4px → 0, scale .985 → 1 (+4px when flipped up)                       |
| Phone bottom sheets                          | 260ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, 28px → 0                                                             |
| Suggestions                                  | 160ms, 4px → 0, scale .985 → 1                                                                          |
| Tabs, mode tabs, chevrons, copy-ID icon      | 150ms ease                                                                                              |
| Composer tint, Send                          | 200ms ease                                                                                              |
| Row shimmer · load-more skeleton             | 1,100ms ease loop · 1,200ms ease-in-out loop                                                            |
| Contact card · team card                     | open after 280ms / 160ms; close after 220ms / 200ms                                                     |

Reduced motion: everything 1ms, no delays, one iteration, shimmer stops.

**States** (`leads.md:371–383`; §6.0): table reload — rows stay, text turns
to shimmer bars, clicks blocked until the page lands (the prototype's
160–380ms is simulation, D15); empty — "No leads match" (centred 12.5px) with
"Clear filters" when filters or search apply, else "New lead" (PRD.md:232,
§7.1); list error — toast "Couldn’t load this list · connection dropped.
Showing the last copy." + "Retry" (9,000ms); load-more error — the same toast
(the prototype never fails it); drawer save — "Saving…", then the footer line,
"Retry save" and the save toast; chat — the empty card, per-message "Not sent"

- "Retry", the outage line; New lead search "No existing match"; people and
  Team lists "No match"; Suggestions "No template matches “<query>”". The
  prototype's "Pick a lead on the left" (H:1825) has no route to show it.

**Access** (`S:22–25`; §3.7): the route admits Front desk, Counsellor,
Marketing, Admin and Owner (schema). In-room, the fixture matrix seeds the
prototype's defaults — View, Create and Edit for Admin, Doctor, Front desk and
Counsellor; Delete for Admin (H:3605–3606, `leads.md:7`) — plus Marketing
(Q-L5) and Owner (full); Doctor's room access is a backend request. "New lead"
hides without Create; Save lead, Remove lead, Convert, Claim and Assign are
gated (the prototype gates neither Save nor Remove).

**Not built** (dead): the collapsed-rail list (H:1674–1678, `ldRailClosed`
false at H:6125), the lead "New task" drawer (H:1869–1882), the New lead edit
variant, the timeline filter (`ldTl`, H:5643), the hold-days dropdown (H:5738) and the legacy
statuses in `applyStatus` (H:5633) — Q-L11.

### 6.4 Appointments (`appointments/`, `appointments/create/`, `appointments/$appointmentId/`)

**Routes** (§4, D24, D27; `S:26–29`):

- `appointments/` is the page. `appointments/create/` and
  `appointments/$appointmentId/` (files `appointment-id.route.tsx`,
  `APPOINTMENT_ID.OVERVIEW.md`; show **is** edit, `S:28`) are URL-driven
  dialogs over it; `/appointments/$appointmentId/edit` is a `routeTree.tsx`
  redirect (`S:29`).
- `appointments.search.ts`: `view=agenda*|day|week|month` (D27; the schema's
  `day|week|list`, default `day`, is stale — Appendix F), `date` (clinic-local
  `YYYY-MM-DD`; in Agenda the one day picked in Filters, else "from today on";
  in Day / Week / Month the anchor), `doctor` (many ids), `status` (`active`*,
  `all`, `scheduled`, `confirmed`, `checked_in`, `completed`, `cancelled`,
  `no_show`), `q`, `created`, `followUp`, `sort` (Agenda:
  `contact|service|status`, ±). The schema's `type`
  filter has no designed control (B.13 R28) and is not offered. Below `md` a
  `view=week` link renders Day and replaces the URL (Week is not offered on
  phone, H:5941).
- `create/` takes the schema's `date`, `time`, `doctor`,
  `who=<patientId|leadId>` and `copyOf=<appointmentId>` (`S:27`), plus
  plan-only `source=chat|task` (step 1 collapsed, Date & time open; `chat`
  also fills Reason from the person's last inbound message, read from the
  thread and never carried in the URL). Opened from another room's page,
  `create/` and `$appointmentId/` carry the referrer `from` that §4 gives
  Invoices — an allow-list of room paths (Today, the patient-file sections,
  Tasks; default `/appointments`) rendered behind the drawer (shared with
  §6.6, AMBER A-P1). Opened from inside another drawer (the lead drawer, the
  task drawer) the form stacks as a child with no URL (`S:116`).
  `$appointmentId` takes plan-only `mode=reschedule`
  (title "Reschedule #<seq>"). Unknown id → the page renders, no drawer, toast
  "Appointment not found · it may have been deleted" (`S:115`).
- Section tone sky; icon `Calendar` 16 (`appointments.md:11, 288`). "Today" is
  the clinic-local date on the real clock — the prototype's device date
  clamped to 9:00–19:59 is simulation (`appointments.md:11`, D15).
- Data: Agenda reads `listAppointments` in cursor pages of 50 (`S:1603`, D7);
  Day / Week / Month read `listAppointmentsRange` for the visible range, no
  paging (`S:1602`); both branch-scoped from the header picker.

**Toolbar** (`appointments.md:17`; shared room toolbar, §3.5; H:1991–2029):

- h1 "Appointments" 20/600 + hairline · view tabs "Agenda" · "Day" · "Week" ·
  "Month" (`role="tablist"` "View", 28px segments) · on Day / Week / Month only:
  "Today" / "This week" / "This month" (36px; tooltip "Jump to the current
  day" / "… week" / "… month") + the period group (36px: 34px arrows
  `ChevronLeft` / `ChevronRight` — the prototype's "‹ ›" glyphs — aria
  "Previous day" / "Next day" and the week / month pairs; label min 150px,
  13.5/600: "Sat 3 Oct 2026", "27 Sep – 3 Oct", "October 2026") · spacer ·
  search ("Patient, phone or #ID", tooltip "Search · press /"; 36px square
  until used, 200px (150–220) in 220ms; 300ms debounce; name, phone and seq,
  spaces and "#" ignored, Q-A12) · Filters (36px `ListFilter` 15, count pill,
  joined × "Clear all filters") · "New appointment" (36px, primary, `Plus` 16;
  hidden without create).
- Agenda has no period control and no past paging: it lists from today on, or
  the one day picked in Filters, past days included (H:5902, H:1994) — as
  designed; the proposed Q-A17 "Period control in Agenda" is withdrawn
  (AMBER A-A1).
- **Tablet (`md`–`xl`):** compact paddings (§3.1); h1 18px
  (`md:text-lg xl:text-xl`, H:148); the tabs shrink to min 120px and scroll

- **Phone (below `md`):** padding 8px 12px; h1 hidden (H:45); row 1 = search

  `calc(var(--floating-bottom-offset) + 16px)` (H:55, D30; as §6.3).

**Agenda** — the shared `DataTable` (L-15) grouped by day, with a `regrid`
phone layout (H:2031–2052; `appointments.md:26–40`):

| Column        | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Width                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Time          | "10:30 am" 13.5/600 tabular over "<n> min" 11.5px                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | 76px                  |
| Contact       | 32px avatar (sage + 14px "P" patient, lav lead, grey other), name 13/500, phone 11.5px; click opens the form; hover 280ms → contact card                                                                                                                                                     | `minmax(150px,1.6fr)` |
| Service       | 24px pill in the service tone                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `minmax(96px,1fr)`    |

- Gap 10px; minimum 790px, scrolling sideways inside the card with the header;

  "Appointed to", "Latest update", "Status"). Rows ≈53px, 3px inline-start

- Sort: Contact (A–Z), Service, Status (Scheduled → Confirmed → Checked in →
  Completed → Cancelled → No show) within each day group; asc → desc → off.
- Day groups: sticky header on the tone tint at 55%: 34px date tile (day 14px
  over month 9px uppercase; today sage, other days cycling sky, lav, blush,
  butter, mint) · "Today" / "Tomorrow" / weekday · sub ("In <n> days", "Next

  confirmed" · "<n> awaiting reply" or "<n> confirmed · all set" (tooltip "<n>
  confirmed · <n> waiting for a reply"). With cursor paging a day can straddle
  two pages, so the group counts need a per-day summary (Appendix F).
- "Latest update" is server data; the prototype synthesises it from the id
  (H:5909–5913). Reminder states, "Replied Yes" and the move count are backend
  requests; "Plan ready" derives from `OfferingSuggestion` (`S:352`).
- Default filter Active = Scheduled, Confirmed, Checked in — in Agenda **and**
  the calendars; the prototype's calendars also count Completed and No show
  (H:5903 vs H:5924; Q-A5).
- End line "All appointments loaded" between hairlines; the prototype renders
  every row at once (H:2051) — cursor pages of 50 with infinite scroll (D7).
  Empty: "No appointments here · " + "book one" (opens a new appointment;
  hidden without create, H:2050).
- **Tablet:** six columns, Latest update dropped — `84px minmax(0,1.5fr)
minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr) 40px 160px`, header included, no sideways
  scroll (H:144–147).
- **Phone:** card flush (no radius, side borders or shadow), header hidden,
  each row re-gridded to `60px minmax(0,1fr) auto`: time spans rows 1–2 ·

**Appointment card** (hover and quick view; `appointments.md:149–163`,
H:2090–2095, H:6115–6118):

- 340px, padding 12px, max height `100vh − 16px`; below the trigger when 300px

  end. Body: service and status pills · "<day> · <h:mm am> · <n> min" · doctor

  Confirmed · Checked in · Completed (20px circles: done ✓ on the tint, current

  (`destructive`), "Confirmed", "Checked in". They obey the popover's guards —
  the prototype's card has none (H:6118 vs H:5974; Q-A7). "Cancel" opens the
  status popover's cancel view; "Reschedule" opens `?mode=reschedule`;

**Change status** popover (`appointments.md:165–179`; H:2112–2119, H:5974):

- 260px, padding 8px, under the Status button (above when less than 260px
  remain below, H:5918), inline-end edge on the button, clamped 8px; phone: the

  PATIENT — "Patient asked", "Could not reach patient"; CLINIC — "Doctor

  so it opens the shared reason confirm with Other picked (AMBER A-A3).
- Result toast "<name> → <status>" + " · reminder queued" (Confirmed) or " ·
  <reason> · slot freed, reminders stopped" (Cancelled), with "Undo" for 10s
  (D32). Undo reverts the status and its side effects (§7.3).

**Status machine** — one transition table and guard set for the popover, the
card, the form tiles and Today (Q-A7), pure functions `allowedNext`,
`transitionGuard`, `formTiles`, `nextAction`, unit-tested
(`S:1137–1145`, H:3422, H:5899–5900, H:5974, H:6038):

| From                            | Next (popover)                                                   | Guards and effects                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Scheduled                       | Confirmed · Checked in · Move to another time · Cancel · No show | Checked in only on the visit day ("Only on <day>"); No show only after the start ("Available after <time> on <day>"); disabled at 45% |
| Confirmed                       | Checked in · Move to another time · Cancel · No show             | same guards                                                                                                                           |
| Checked in                      | Completed                                                        | patients only — a lead or contact needs a patient record first                                                                        |
| Completed · Cancelled · No show | —                                                                | "Final status. Use Rebook to make a new appointment."                                                                                 |

- "Move to another time" is the Reschedule mode, not a status; reschedule
  returns the booking to Scheduled with `rescheduledFrom` (`S:344`).
- Side effects — server rules, a fixture job now (Q-T3): Scheduled (new or
  moved) → a "Confirm" task (`confirm_visit`, `S:1506`); No show → a "No-show"
  task (outcomes Rebooked · Not interested · No answer); Completed → a
  "Feedback" task due tomorrow (H:5899) — both kinds are backend requests;
  Checked in or Completed → every open lead of the person → Clinic visited plus
  a system line (`S:1610`, H:6047).

**Appointment form** — one shared unit, `src/shared/forms/AppointmentForm/`,
mounted by `create/` and `$appointmentId/` and stacked as a child drawer by the
lead drawer (§6.3) and the task drawer (§6.10) (`appointments.md:57–101,
121–133, 227–270`; H:2741–2866, H:5983–6051, H:4136–4150):

- **Shape:** right drawer, full height, modal; backdrop `bg-overlay/45` and
  panel 340ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`; 36px × at top 14px, 10px outside the
  inline-start edge (200ms after 200ms). The prototype also casts a 100vmax
  shadow at α .4 behind the panel, a second dim (H:2742) — one overlay here
  (AMBER A-A4). Header 76px (60px phone): title 18/600 "New appointment" /
  "Appointment #<seq>" / "Reschedule #<seq>", sub "Only free slots are offered
  · past times are locked". No initial focus target (the who search has no
  autofocus, `appointments.md:133`); the sheet still traps and returns focus.
- **Widths** (pure `appointmentFormWidths(vw, pref, mode)`, unit-tested):
  create `min(760, max(560, vw − 56))`; edit = form `min(760, max(560, vw −
chat − 56))` + chat `max(360, min(pref ‖ 420, min(980, 0.94vw) − 400))`
  (H:5983, H:4572) — 1440: 760 + 420 = 1,180. At 820 that is 560 + 371 = 931px,
  wider than the window, and at 1024 the × is clipped (`appointments.md:126`)
  — built: when form + chat > `vw − 56`, total = `vw − 56`, chat = `max(360,
min(chat, total − 400))`, form = the rest: 1024 → 548 + 420, 820 → 400 + 364,
  768 → 352 + 360; 1,280 and up unchanged (D33, §7.3). The chat column takes
  the lead-chat width pref and has no handle here.
- **Container rule:** the form body is an `@container`; below 520px of its own
  width the labels stack above their fields (6px gap) and step 2 puts the
  calendar above the slots. That is the phone layout (H:32–34) and the narrow
  tablet edit form — and it fixes the phone's 210px calendar leaving about
  100px for slots (H:2778; §7.3).
- **Phone (below `md`):** full width, no chat column (`appointments.md:126`);
  the × sits inside the header (top 8px, 44×44) — the prototype's
  left-anchored × lands off-screen and leaves only "Cancel" (H:2742, H:27;
  D33); footer wraps with 44px buttons (H:35–38).
- **Dismiss:** "Cancel", ×, backdrop, Esc. Create has no guard; edit asks
  "Discard changes?" when dirty (Q-P1).

| Mode                            | Opened by                                                                                                                   | Sections                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| New                             | "New appointment" (toolbar, phone pill, ⌘K per Q-A15), "book one", an empty Day slot, contact card "+ Appointment" (H:5681) | who · 1 Appointment · 2 Date & time; no status strip, no chat; saves Scheduled                                                                                                                       |
| New, step 1 collapsed           | lead composer "Book an appointment" (stacked, §6.3), a Task, "Copy" (`copyOf`), "Rebook" (`copyOf`)                         | as New with the step 1 summary shown and Date & time open; Copy / Rebook keep person, service, doctor, length, reason and notes, date today, no time, toast "Copied · pick a date and time" (H:4147) |
| Reschedule (`?mode=reschedule`) | "Move to another time", "Reschedule"                                                                                        | who, 1 and 2 prefilled — the booking's date, or today when it has passed (H:5895); no status strip, no chat; saves Scheduled with a "Moved" badge and a Confirm task                                 |
| Edit                            | a row, a block, "Open", an "Appointment #…" chat pill                                                                       | Visit status above the steps; chat column (`md` and up); patient sections, or step 3 for a non-patient                                                                                               |

**Motion** (`appointments.md:312–326`):

| Element                                               | Duration and easing                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Form panel and backdrop                               | 340ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`                           |
| Floating ×                                            | 200ms after 200ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, scale .9 → 1 |
| Step 1 body                                           | 240ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, −4px → 0                  |
| Filters, appointment card, change status, day popover | 160ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, −4px → 0, scale .985 → 1  |
| Phone bottom sheets                                   | 260ms `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, 28px → 0                 |
| Status tiles, view tabs, chevrons                     | 150ms ease                                                  |
| Appointment card                                      | opens after 420ms, closes after 160ms                       |
| Shimmer                                               | 1,100ms ease loop                                           |

Reduced motion: 1ms, no delays, one iteration, shimmer stops.

**States** (`appointments.md:328–343`; §6.0): Agenda reload — rows stay with
shimmering text, clicks blocked until the page lands; Day / Week / Month —
the page skeleton over the grid after Apply (the prototype's 160–380ms and
260–560ms are simulation, D15); Agenda empty "No appointments here · book
one"; Day empty "Free all day", empty grid, strip chips without counts;
Week / Month empty columns or cells; list error — toast "Couldn’t load this
list · connection dropped. Showing the last copy." + "Retry" (9,000ms); form
open — skeleton only while `getAppointment` is pending; who search — nothing
under 2 characters, no match → only "+ Create contact “<query>”"; slots "Pick a
date to see times", a full day struck through at 55%; package empty; form save
as above; photos via the upload tray; suggestions "Nothing suggested for
<first> yet."; chat as §6.3.

**Access** (`S:26–29`; §3.7): the route admits Front desk, Doctor, Therapist,

(H:3605–3606, `appointments.md:7`); Owner full. "New appointment", "book one"
and slot clicks hide without Create; status changes, Cancel visit, Restore and
Save are gated by Edit (Q-A16); Therapists get read-only drawers.

### 6.5 Patients (`patients/`, `patients/create/`)

**Routes** (§4, D24): `patients/` is the list page; `patients/create/` is the
New patient drawer as a URL-driven dialog over it (`S:31`, query
`?name=&phone=&fromLead=<leadId>` prefills First / Last name and Mobile and sets
`Patient.leadId`, `S:317`). Edit patient is the patient file's
`patients/$patientId/edit/` (§6.6, `S:34`); the list's row "Edit" opens it.
`patients.search.ts`: `view=all*|today|dues|follow|recall`, `q`, `types`,
`status`, `gender`, `conversion`, `created`, `followUp`, `sort`
(`S:30`; `recall`, `gender`, `conversion` and the extra sort keys are
backend requests, Appendix F). Section tone sage (`patients.md:11`).
Entry points: header tab, phone tab bar, ⌘K "Go to · Patients" and the ⌘K
action "New patient" (→ `patients/create`), "Back to patients" and the
breadcrumb in the file (`patients.md:5`); the contact card's "+ Patient" opens
`patients/create?name=&phone=&fromLead=` (the prototype silently writes to its
legacy `PATIENTS` set, H:5682 — §7.3).

**Toolbar** (`patients.md:17`; shared room toolbar, §3.5):

- Order fixed: h1 "Patients" (20/600, hairline after) · view tabs · spacer ·
  search · saved views (only once one is saved) · Filters · Columns ·
  "New patient" (36px, primary, `Plus` 16).
- View tabs, icons 14px: "All" `Users` · "In clinic today" `House` · "With dues"
  `Wallet` · "Follow-up due" `Bell` · "Recall" `RefreshCw` (H:4720,
  `patients.md:203–207`).
- Search: 36px icon square → 150–220px in 220ms on click or "/"; placeholder
  "Name, mobile or #ID", label "Search patients", tooltip "Search · press /";
  300ms debounce, `q` on name, phone and seq (`S:1619`), "#" stripped.
- Columns: `Eye`, aria "Show or hide columns", tooltip "Columns · 6 of 9 shown",
  dark count badge of hidden columns (`patients.md:141`).
- **Tablet (`md`–`xl`):** as desktop; h1 18px (`md:text-lg xl:text-xl`,
  H:148); the view tabs shrink to a 120px minimum and scroll sideways (H:142);
  toolbar and gutters use the compact spacing variables (§3.1).
- **Phone (below `md`):** padding 8px 12px; h1 and spacer hidden (H:45, H:53);
  row 1 = search, always expanded, 40px tall, `flex: 1 1 180px`, "/" hint hidden
  (H:46–49) + Filters 40px (H:51–52); row 2 = view tabs at full width, scrolling
  sideways without a scrollbar (H:54, H:93), saved views after them; Columns
  hidden (H:92). "New patient" becomes a floating pill: 52px, `rounded-full`
  (`data-slot="pill"`), padding 0 20px 0 16px, 14px text, shadow
  `0 10px 28px −8px` (H:55), fixed 16px from the inline end, in the phone
  bottom stack (§3.2): `calc(var(--floating-bottom-offset) + 16px +
env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` — the prototype's 74px is the 58px tab bar + 16
  (D30) — and above the View-as pill when one shows (`--floating-notice-height`;
  the prototype overlaps them, D33).
