**Views are server queries** (`listPatients`, `S:1619`), never client filters
over a page:

- All — every patient.
- In clinic today (`today`) — Q-P4: an appointment checked in today (the
  schema's derivation, `S:319`) or an open Visit (D18); the prototype matches
  follow-up = today (H:4693), a defect.
- With dues (`dues`) — Σ invoice due > 0 (`S:319`).
- Follow-up due (`follow`) — follow-up past or today (H:4693).
- Recall — status Inactive (H:4693); prototype-only view, backend request.
- View and sort changes keep the current rows until the new page arrives
  (`placeholderData`), with no skeleton, as in the prototype (H:4475,
  `patients.md:253`).

Yesterday · Last 7 days · Last 30 days · This month · Custom range) and
"Follow-up date" (Any · Overdue · Today · Tomorrow · Next 7 days · Not set ·
Custom range); "Custom range" adds "From" / "To". The prototype builds the
badge sections from the loaded rows (2–10 distinct values, H:4164); with server pages
the build lists each enum's values (contract over source). Picks stay pending
until "Apply filter"; footer "Save as view" / "Saved as view"; header "Clear
all"; the Filters button gets a count badge and a joined × "Clear all filters".
Toasts "View “Female + Aesthetic” saved", "View removed". **Phone:** a bottom
sheet, full width, max-height 82%, top corners 16px, slides up 260ms
`cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, no dim (H:41). **Tablet:** as desktop.

### 6.6 Patient file (`patients/$patientId/`, `timeline/` … `notes/`, `edit/`)

**Resolved:** Overview ships and is the default section (D19); slugs come from
the schema and labels from the prototype (D26); the visit flow runs on the
shared Visit model (D18).

**Routes and sections** (§4, D24, D26). `patients/$patientId/` is the layout
(file bar, main card = rail + content column, Activity column); its index
redirects to `timeline` (D19 — the schema redirects to `overview`, `S:32`, a
Standing deviation). Eleven literal section folders; an unknown section renders
the default (`S:33`). Layout search (`patient-id.search.ts`):
`activity=open|closed` — absent means the state last left this session
(`useUIStore`, never persisted). The schema's `team` has no tab and is not
built (D26).

**Dialog routes** — each section's dialogs nest under it (§4, `S:34–47`):

- `edit/` — Edit patient (the §6.5 drawer) over `overview`.
- `prescriptions/create/` · `prescriptions/$prescriptionId/` (Print preview —
  the schema's "Prescription viewer · Print from here", `S:36`) ·
  `prescriptions/$prescriptionId/edit/`.
- `treatments/create/` · `treatments/$treatmentId/edit/` (show = edit, `S:39`).
- `images/$imageId/` (the full-bleed viewer) · `images/$imageId/edit/` (Photo
  details).
- `reports/create/` (Upload report) · `reports/$reportId/` (Report view).
- `check-ins/create/?appointment=&treatment=` · `check-ins/$checkInId/edit/` ·
  `reviews/create/?source=&appointment=` · `reviews/$reviewId/edit/` — over
  `overview`, where the Feedback card lives (`S:44–47`).
- AMBER A-F1: "Edit contact" (rail, any section) and the Treatments row
  "Check-in" open these from other sections; the prototype keeps the section
  behind (one page), the schema puts `overview` behind. Default: an optional,
  validated `from=<section>` (the D26 enum, default `overview`) keeps the
  section the user was on — the Invoices referrer pattern (§4).
- No URL (D24, `S:112, 116`): the section popover, the Add-to-record menu, the
  Log feedback picker, Add package (no schema route — packages come from
  invoices, `S:452–466`; AMBER A-F6), delete confirms, toasts.
- Cross-room drawers opened from the file keep it behind them through the
  `from` referrer rule: the invoice drawer (`/invoices/create?type=clinic&patient=`,
  `/invoices/$invoiceId`, `/invoices/$invoiceId/edit`) — §6.9's allow-list
  already names the patient file's sections; receive payment
  (`/payments/receive?patient=&invoice=`), the appointment form
  (`/appointments/create?who=<patientId>`, `/appointments/$appointmentId`) and
  the Medical sale (`/medical/sales/create?prescription=`) need the same rule
  (AMBER A-P1). Give back is a stacked drawer without a URL (§6.9).

**Layout** (H:702–877; `patient-file.md:13–26`):

- A column on z50: the file bar, then the body grid inside the room gutter

  only estimates the content width for the bento and never matches the real

  then the content column (section header + section content; each section

**Visit flow** (D18; one Visit model with the Visit sheet, §6.13, L-49;
H:758–768, H:4871–4898; `patient-file.md:92–101, 392–404`): replaces the
Overview on `timeline/` while `?visit=open` (`timeline.search.ts`); the section
header hides.

- "Start visit" opens the patient's open Visit or starts one (D18: checking in
  today's appointment starts it; with none today, a Visit without an
  appointment — the Visit model's call, L-49) and navigates to
  `timeline?visit=open`. "Visit in progress · Resume" → the same URL. "Pause"
  drops `visit`; the Visit and its step state stay open (`vState` per patient,
  H:4871). A deep link with `visit=open` and no open Visit shows the Overview
  and drops the param — navigation never mutates.
- "✓ Complete visit" completes the Visit and its appointment (D18), uses a
  package session when today's treatment carries a `packageId` (`S:414`), sets
  the follow-up from the visit Rx's `followUpDate` when there is one (the
  prototype hard-codes "Oct 26 · 11:00", H:4897; AMBER A-F8), toast "Visit
  completed · 1 package session used · follow-up set for 26 Oct" (each part only
  when it happened).
- Layout: one column, max 880px, gap 10, padding 16px 20px 24px. Header row:
  sage pill "Visit in progress" (7px dot) · "Everything for today's visit on one
  screen" · "Pause" (outline 32px) · "✓ Complete visit" (primary 32px). Five
  step cards (padding 14, radius 12; the current card has a strong border):
  26px circle — success ✓ done, dark current, muted later; title 14/600; status
  line 12px. No Next; only step 3 is gated on step 1.
  1. "Check-in & safety" — tiles "Consent signed" ("Treatment can't start
     without it") · "Before photos taken" ("Auto-paired with after photos") ·
     "Allergies & medicines checked" ("Asked at every visit"); "2 checks left" →
     "All checks done".
  2. "Prescription" — ⚡ "Hair fall kit" · "Post-peel kit" · "Pigmentation kit"
     (one tap saves an Rx, toast "Hair fall kit prescribed"; Doctor / Admin) ·
     "Write prescription" → `prescriptions/create`; "One tap from a kit, or
     write one" → the medicine names.
  3. "Treatment" — "⚡ Repeat · LHR Full Face · session 2" (only with a past
     treatment; toast "Session 2 recorded with last settings") · "New
     treatment"; "Remembered for this patient: Soprano Ice · 10 J · 3 Hz · 810 nm
     · Type IV"; package pill "Uses 1 session of LHR Full Face · B4G7"; both
     blocked with "Finish check-in first" until step 1 is done; "Record today's
     session" / "Last settings: …" → "LHR Full Face · session 2".
  4. "Invoice" — the item list + "Total"; "Create invoice from visit" (toast
     "Invoice #1043 created from the visit"; "Nothing to bill" when empty) ·
     "Custom invoice"; "2 items ready · ₹6,250" / "Covered by package · nothing
     to bill" / "Nothing to bill yet" / "#1043 · ₹6,250".
  5. "Collect & share" — when due "Collect ₹1,500 · UPI" · "Cash" · "Card" (the
     first unpaid invoice in full, toast "₹1,500 received by UPI") and always
     "Share Rx, invoice & photos" (`WhatsAppMark`; toast "Rx, invoice and photos
     sent to Dharti Galani on WhatsApp"); "₹1,500 due" / "Nothing due" → "Sent
     on WhatsApp".
- Motion: the page fades in 240ms (−4px). **Phone:** full width; the safety
  tiles stack (auto-fit, 200px minimum); the header row wraps — pill and line
  on row 1, Pause and Complete on row 2 (the prototype has no phone rule and
  overflows at 390px — §7.3). **Tablet:** as desktop.

Anaesthesia toggle 150ms; skeleton 1.1s; reduced motion → .01ms (H:15, H:379).

### 6.7 Medical (`medical/sales/` … `medical/payments/`)

Section tone blush (`medical.md:11`). Built by **`fe-design-ditto`** with
`fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island` (seven tab pages), `fe-resource-crud`
(16 dialog routes), `fe-routing-tenancy` (the redirect, gates), `shadcn`
(`sheet`, `tabs`, `popover`, `command`, `toggle-group`, `accordion`),
`fe-http-forms-errors` (every drawer), `fe-locale-formatting` (₹, dates),
`fe-rtl-logical-css`, `fe-i18n-constants` (namespace `medical`),
`fe-e2e-testids` and `fe-test-generation`.

**Routes** (§4, D24, D25; `S:48–71`):

- `/medical` redirects to `/medical/sales` (`S:48`, D25). The prototype opens
  on Medicines (`s.mdSec||'cat'`, H:5309; `medical.md:5`) — demo state.
- Seven literal tab folders, in the prototype's order (H:5433):
  `medical/sales/` · `medical/medicines/` · `medical/purchases/` ·
  `medical/suppliers/` · `medical/manufacturers/` · `medical/mrs/` ·
  `medical/payments/`. Toolbar, tab track, Create menu and view action live in
  the family `medical/shared/` folder (§4).
- 16 URL-driven dialogs (each `<page>.route.tsx` renders `null`; the tab page
  reads the URL and opens the drawer): `sales/create/`
  (`?prescription=&customer=`), `sales/$saleId/` (view), `sales/$saleId/return/`,
  `medicines/create/` (`?name=`), `medicines/$medicineId/edit/` (row click),
  `purchases/create/` (`?supplier=`), `purchases/$purchaseOrderId/` (view),
  `purchases/$purchaseOrderId/edit/` (stage `ordered` only, else redirect →
  view, `S:59`), `purchases/$purchaseOrderId/receive/`, `suppliers/create/`,
  `suppliers/$supplierId/edit/`, `manufacturers/create/`,
  `manufacturers/$manufacturerId/edit/`, `mrs/create/`, `mrs/$mrId/edit/`,
  `mrs/$mrId/visits/create/` (`S:50–70`).
- No URL (`S:112`, `S:116`): stacked child drawers, quick creates, Create menu,
  More tabs, "Prescriptions to fill", Browse, Filters, the reason confirm — and
  **Return expiring stock**, which the schema lists neither as a route nor as
  an operation (component-state drawer over Medicines; Appendix F).
- `medical.search.ts` per tab (`S:49–71`): Sales `status=all|unpaid|returned`,
  `q`, `created`; Medicines `stock=all|low`, `expiry=any|30|60|90`,
  `manufacturer`, `q`; Purchases `stage`, `supplier`, `q`, `created`; Suppliers,
  Manufacturers, MRs `q`; Payments = the ledger query with `scope=medical`
  fixed. Applied filters live in the URL, pending ones in component state (§5).

**Toolbar** (`medical.md:17`; H:1354–1537, H:5430–5448):

- h1 "Medical" 20px/600 with a hairline inline-end border.
- Tab track (28px tabs in a 3px `muted` track): Sales (`Receipt`) · Medicines
  (`Pill`) · Purchases (`Package`) · Suppliers (`Users`) · Manufacturers
  (`Package`) · MRs (`Users`) · Payments (`Wallet`). Tabs that don't fit the
  measured space fold from the inline end into "More ⌄" (`ChevronDown`; 78px
  reserved; the selected tab always stays; ResizeObserver plus the 250ms
  re-measure, H:3998–4008, H:4155). More's list groups "Selling" · "Stock" ·
  "Buying" · "Money" (H:5433). All seven fit at 1440; at 820 the track shows
  "Sales · Medicines · More ⌄" (`medical.md:17`). Medical and Payments are the
  only rooms that run this fit (H:4155) — one `RoomTabs` capability of the room
  toolbar (§3.5).
- Search: 36px icon → 200px (150–220px) in 220ms, "/" focuses, 300ms debounce;
  placeholder "Search name, composition, supplier…", aria "Search medical",
  tooltip "Search · press /" (`medical.md:522`).
- Saved-view chips (after "Save as view") · "Filters" (`ListFilter`, count
  badge, joined "×" "Clear all filters") · Columns (`Eye`, dark count badge
  when columns are hidden).
- **View action**, one per tab and filter state (H:5438–5443,
  `medical.md:17`); icon + label when the measured space allows, else a 36px
  icon-only button (its width is the fit's reserve, H:4155):
  - Medicines + Stock "Low stock" → "Reorder low stock" (`Package`): opens
    `purchases/create/?reorder=low` — every medicine at or below its reorder
    level, qty = fill-up − stock, at the supplier most of them buy from
    (H:5436). `?reorder=low` mirrors Clinic stock's preset (`S:79`); a plan
    search param, not a contract field.
  - Medicines + "Nearest expiry" set → "Sell all at 20% off" / "Remove
    near-expiry discount" (`Tag`); toast "20% off on expiring medicines" with
    Undo (Q-M3).
  - Sales + Status All → "Prescriptions to fill" (`Pill`) — a dropdown, shown
    while unfilled prescriptions exist (see Popups).
  - Sales + Unpaid → "Send payment reminders" (`MessageSquare`) — hidden until
    messaging exists (Q-M6; the prototype only toasts, H:5441).
  - Purchases + Stage Received → "Pay all received · ₹2,980" (`Wallet`) —
    routed through the Pay drawer (Q-M1, see Purchases).
- Split primary "+ New <thing>" (`Plus` 16) with a 32px "⌄" ("Create something
  else"; menu min 220px, groups "Selling" · "Stock" · "Buying", every create
  except the current one; H:5430–5432, `medical.md:385`). Primary per tab:
  Sales "New sale" · Medicines "New medicine" · Purchases "New purchase order" ·
  Suppliers "New supplier" · Manufacturers "New manufacturer" · MRs "New MR" ·
  Payments "New sale" (H:5431).
- Not built (dead in the prototype, B.12): the four stat cards (H:5447, never
  rendered), the per-tab view bars and the expiry radar (H:5434, H:5448
  `isExp:false`).

**Phone and tablet** (D23; `medical.md:17–19`; H:45–61, H:63–75, H:92–93,
H:129, H:141–148):

- Below `md`: h1 visually hidden (`sr-only`, §3.5). Row 1 = search, always open, 40px,
  growing (basis 180px) + "Filters" 40px. Row 2 = the selected tab + "More ⌄"
  (every other tab moves into More, opened as a bottom sheet grouped Selling ·
  Stock · Buying · Money) + the view action as a 36px icon-only button. Columns
  button hidden. The split button leaves the toolbar as §3.5's floating "New"
  (D30): two 52px pills side by side, 8px apart, 16px from the inline end and
  74px + safe area above the bottom — "+ New medicine" (padding 0 20px 0 16px,
  14px) and the chevron pill (the spec's 37px widened to §3.5's 44px touch
  minimum). The table card is edge to edge (no border, radius or
  shadow); header row, footer and checkboxes hidden; no selection (D31).
- `md`–`xl`: h1 18px; the tab track measures (820: "Sales · Medicines · More
  ⌄"); tables fold overflow columns into the primary cell's meta line with
  "N columns in rows · Show all" ↔ "Fit to width" (`Maximize` / `Minimize`;
  fold engine §3.5); row actions always visible on touch (H:221, H:141);
  drawers `min(W, 100vw − 56px)` (840 → 712px at 768, 764px at 820;
  `medical.md:334`).
- `xl:` and up: the desktop layout; compact padding under 1440 wide or 800 tall
  follows §3.1.

status edge; 32px icon-only row actions (13px icons, tooltip = name, danger
last after a separator). Default hidden: Medicines › Best rate, Sales ›
Margin, MRs › Samples (H:4160).

- **Stacked child drawers** (`medical.md:343–355`; H:5312, H:5429): a picker
  footer "New <thing> · “q”" + "full details" opens that record's drawer on top
  — manufacturer, supplier, MR 560, medicine 840 — with its own 45% backdrop,
  the name prefilled, footer "Back" + the record's primary; saving selects the
  new record in the parent field. Below `md` full-screen above the parent. No
  URL (`S:116`). Esc closes the child first; the prototype closes the parent
  and leaves the child open (H:4512, H:5429, §7.3).
- **Quick records** (`medical.md:311–325`; H:5313–5316): "Add manufacturer
  “acme”" → "ACME" in the next tone, toast "Manufacturer ACME added"; "Add
  supplier “Om Pharma”"; "Add MR “Ravi”" → toast "MR Ravi added"; "Add
  medicine “Azel cream”". Enter on the highlighted create row; the new record
  is selected. Contract `isQuick` (`S:750, 765, 812`); `quickCreateMedicine` is
  optimistic (`S:1670`).
- **Steps** (`medical.md:431–438`): §3.5's step cards — the open circle in
  blush ink, done `success` ✓, missing `destructive` "!"; collapsed
  peek ("MEDICINE · 1 ADDED", dashed "Empty", red "Missing: Reason"), "Next:
  <step> →", headers reopen ("Edit" / "Open"); validation never blocks Next;
  Save jumps to the first step missing a required field. **The sequence varies
  by input** — PO by stage (Ordered editable + Receive goods; Received / Paid
  read-only views); sales are never edited; the supplier's Account step and
  840 width only when editing; the expiry row actions only within 90 days; a
  sale from a prescription arrives prefilled. The same on every viewport.
- **Confirm** (Delete / Cancel order / Void sale) — the shared reason confirm
  (§3.5; its phone form per §3.5, D33), 480px: titles "Delete this medicine?" /
  "… supplier?" / "… manufacturer?" / "… MR?", "Cancel this purchase order?",
  "Void this sale?" (the prototype says "Cancel order this purchase order?" and
  "Void sale this sale?", H:4449, §7.3). Bodies and reasons verbatim from
  `medical.md:366`; the record pill is the row's name cell or the drawer
  summary. Delete reasons are the `delete_reason` enum (`S:1490–1496`); Cancel
  order maps "Ordered by mistake" → `mistake` and the rest to `other` with the
  label as the note (D32 pattern; `cancelReason`, `S:828`); Void passes its
  reason to `voidSale` (`S:1668`). Q-M2: a void restores stock and cancels the
  invoice, as the body promises (Appendix F). Undo 10s through restore (D32)
  for deletes; Undo on cancels, voids and discounts is a backend request.

**Access** (`medical.md:7`; H:3605–3606; `S:48`; PRD.md:74): View — Admin,
Pharmacist, Accountant; Create / Edit — Admin, Pharmacist; Delete, Cancel order
and Void sale — Admin. The md, the prototype and the schema agree (the schema
adds Owner, the platform org owner, full; Q-U2). Void also needs the `void`
ability (Q-U8; never checked in the prototype, H:3576–3577). Without Delete the
red actions disappear; without Edit an existing record opens read-only, footer
"View only · your role can’t change this".

**Data** (D6, D22): fixtures behind `REPLACE_WITH_API`, contracts shaped on
`Manufacturer`, `Supplier`, `MedicalRep`, `MRVisit`, `Medicine`,
`MedicalPurchaseOrder`, `MedicalContact`, `MedicalSale` (`S:741–858`).
Medicines and Medical contacts live in `src/shared/api/clinic/` (the Invoice
drawer and the Rx drawer read them); suppliers, manufacturers, MRs, POs and
sales in the family `medical/shared/` (`medical-contracts.ts`,
`medical-api.ts`, `medical.fixtures.ts`). FEFO deduction, stock checks and the
manufacturer link writes are server rules (fixture now). Pure, unit-tested
functions: stock level and tone, nearest expiry and its tone (end of month),
margin, reorder quantity, supplier ageing.

**States** (`medical.md:498–513`): first load and every tab / search / filter
change shimmer the existing rows in place (1,100ms loop; real latency, D15).
Empty — blush tile with `Pill` 18: Sales and Purchases "Nothing in the medicine
store", Medicines "No medicine matches", Suppliers "No supplier matches",
Manufacturers "No manufacturer matches", MRs "No MR matches", Payments "No
Medical payments yet"; hint "Nothing here yet. Try another tab or search."; the
tab's "New …" button (PRD.md:232, B.13 R26 — the prototype passes none,
H:4566). Filtered: `Search` · "No matches" · "Nothing matches these filters.
Clear them to see everything again." · "+ Clear filters". List error: toast
"Couldn’t load this list · connection dropped. Showing the last copy." +
"Retry" (9,000ms; rows stay). Drawers: open shimmer, "Saving…", the failure
footer and toast "Couldn’t save · connection dropped. Everything you entered
is still here." + "Retry". Pickers: "Nothing to pick yet"; "No results for
“zz”" + "Check the spelling or try fewer letters". Success toasts 5,200ms,
bottom-centre 16px (below `md` 76px + safe area).

`cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`; dropdowns, Filters, Browse 160ms

not "Cresence Skin". PO print: Q-M7.

### 6.8 Clinic stock (`stock/items/`, `stock/purchases/`, `stock/movements/`, `stock/vendors/`)

Section tone mint (`clinic-stock.md:11`). Consumables and equipment used in
procedures, never sold, never shared with Medical (`clinic-stock.md:4`). Built
by **`fe-design-ditto`** with `fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island` (four
tab pages), `fe-resource-crud` (7 dialog routes), `fe-routing-tenancy`,
`shadcn` (`sheet`, `popover`, `tabs`, `toggle-group`, `accordion`),
`fe-http-forms-errors`, `fe-locale-formatting` (₹, decimals, dates),
`fe-rtl-logical-css`, `fe-i18n-constants` (namespace `stock`),
`fe-e2e-testids`, `fe-test-generation`.

**Routes** (§4, D24; `S:72–83`):

- `/stock` redirects to `/stock/items` (`S:72`).
- Literal tab folders: `stock/items/`, `stock/purchases/`, `stock/movements/`
  — the prototype's three, in its order (H:5280) — and `stock/vendors/`

### 6.9 Payments (`payments/`, `payments/pending/`, `payments/day-close/`) and the shared Invoice drawer (`invoices/`)

Section tone peach (`payments.md:11`). One ledger of money in and out, the
pending credits, the daily cash close, and the Invoice drawer every room
shares. Built by **`fe-design-ditto`** with `fe-page-scaffolding` →
`fe-route-island` (`payments/`, `payments/pending/`, `invoices/`),
`fe-resource-crud` (9 dialog routes), `fe-routing-tenancy` (the `from`
allow-list, day-locked redirects), `shadcn` (`sheet`, `tabs`, `toggle-group`,
`popover`, `command`, `accordion`, `tooltip`), `fe-http-forms-errors` (every
money write; conflict = day closed), `fe-resilient-interactions`
(single-flight saves, idempotency keys on money writes),
`fe-locale-formatting` (₹ Indian grouping, U+2212 minus, dates),
`fe-rtl-logical-css`, `fe-i18n-constants` (namespaces `payments`, `invoices`),
`fe-e2e-testids`, `fe-test-generation`.

**Routes** (§4, D24; `S:84–94`):

- `/payments` is the ledger page itself (`payments/`, first tab "Payments";
  no slug, no redirect, `S:84`); `/payments/pending` is the Pending page
  (`payments/pending/`, `S:88`).
- Dialogs over `/payments`: `receive/` (`?patient=&invoice=`), `pay/`
  (`?bill=md:<poId>|is:<purchaseId>`), `$paymentId/edit/` (Receive or Send by
  direction; only while its day is open — a closed day redirects to the ledger
  with the toast "PAY-5509 · Day closed"), `day-close/` (`?date=YYYY-MM-DD`,
  default today; `?branch=`). Over `/payments/pending`: `pending/create/`
  (`?direction=give|take`), `pending/$creditId/edit/` (only while open)
  (`S:85–91`).

  (H:5067, H:3848, §7.3); the build shows them above the footer (AMBER
  placement).
- **Money math** — one shared module (§5), unit-tested: line base = qty ×
  rate; the line discount comes off the base; GST is charged on the discounted
  amount (H:3631; `S:635`); bill = round(subtotal − discounts + GST − overall
  discount − credit note) (H:3632). The prototype takes the overall % after GST;
  Q-G7 applies it before tax. The UI keeps the % field; the contract stores
  `overallDiscount` in paise (`S:616`, C24), converted against the subtotal
  after line discounts. Status: "Paid" (due 0) / "Partly paid" / "Due" (H:3633),
  stored as `paid` / `partial` / `unpaid` (`S:621`). The server computes the
  totals on save (`S:1716`); the module mirrors them for the live preview.

  patient" / "Pick a customer" → "Add at least one item" → "Paid ₹X is more than

  price" / "… has more discount than allowed · raise the final price or ask an
  admin" — then `createInvoice` / `updateInvoice` (`S:1716`), or `createSale`
  for Medical (`S:1666`; batches by earliest expiry). Offerings with more than
  one session create patient packages; matching plan rows turn "Invoiced"; a
  balance opens a "Payment due" task (fixture rule, Q-T3). Submit "Create
  clinic invoice" / "Create medical invoice" / "Create consultation invoice" /
  "Save changes"; red Delete on edit (the `void` ability, Q-U8); "Cancel";
  summary "Medical · Rhea Shah · 1 item". Toasts "Medical invoice #788 created"
  (+ " · N offering suggestions items marked invoiced"), "Invoice #787 saved".
  The page behind stays (D28).

  1. **Gate** — card: 44px peach tile with `Wallet` 20 · "OPENING CASH ·

     Appendix F). Toast "Opening cash ₹2,000 accepted · stamped 09:12"
     (`acceptOpeningCash`, `S:1714`). `opening_source` has `carried` and

     S. · 09:12" (success) — "Cash in · out" "+₹0 −₹260" · "Expected in drawer
     ₹1,740" — "Counted now" ₹ input (32px, "Count the drawer", aria "Counted
     cash") + difference pill ("—" muted, "₹0" sage, "+₹X" / "−₹X" blush) —

     ₹X · out ₹Y") + staff chips (20px avatar + amount; tooltip "Farah A. · 1

     day" without a count → toast "Count the cash first"; closing toasts "Day

     (sub "Accepted by Riya S." / "Taken as expected") · "Collected" ₹600 sage
     "1 received" · "Paid out" ₹3,460 blush "2 paid" · "Cash counted" ₹1,700
     "Expected ₹1,740" · "Difference" "₹0" "Drawer matched" sage / "+₹X" "Extra
     in drawer" / "−₹40" "Short in drawer" blush / "—" · "What happened" log

minmax(160px,1fr) 90px 110px 110px auto`, gap 10px, padding 8px 16px, 12.5px;

expected cash, ageing and invoice totals are server-derived, mirrored by pure,

### 6.10 Tasks (`tasks/`, `tasks/create/`, `tasks/$taskId/`)

- **Routes** (§4, D24): `/tasks` page; `/tasks/create` and `/tasks/$taskId` are
  URL-driven dialogs over it (S:95–97). `tasks.search.ts`: `tab=queue*|snoozed|done`
  labelled "To do · Snoozed · Done" (S:95; `tasks.md:299`; the stored status is the
  schema's `open` "Queue", S:1519–1524, D22), `q` (≤80), `type` (rule keys, multi),
  `scope=mine*|everyone`. Section tone plum.

  prototype's matrix omits Pharmacist and Accountant and makes Therapist
  view-only (`tasks.md:7`; H:3605–3606). Outcomes, snooze and reassign need View
  only (`tasks.md:7`); "New task" needs `tasks.create` (S:96). "Mine" = mine +
  unowned; "Everyone" = every owner, offered to every role as designed — the
  schema returns all owners only to Owner/Admin (S:95, S:1722), so that is a
  backend request (Appendix F; AMBER).
- **Data:** `listTasks` (cursor pages of 50, sort `dueAt` asc, S:1722; D7 — the
  prototype renders the whole list, `tasks.md:36`) and `getTask` (task + source
  record + activity, S:1723); refetch every 60s and after every outcome. Rule

    `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr))`, gap 8px (2 per row at 1440, 1 on phone):
    label 10.5px/600 uppercase + value 13px/500 ellipsis — appointment: Visit ·
    Service · Doctor · Status; treatment: Treatment · Done on · Session · Therapist;
    lead (or a person with a lead): Status · Source · Interested in · Owner · Mobile;
    patient-only: none. (4) "2 · How" — 3 numbered steps (22px `muted` circles,
    11px/600; 13px text) per rule (`tasks.md:334–346`). (5) "Clinozy can do this" card
    for rules with an automation (dashed `border-strong`, `rounded-xl`, padding 12px;
    32px `primary` tile with `Sparkles`; 13px/600 + automation 12px; "Let Clinozy do
    it" 32px, 1px `primary` border) → resolves "Done by Clinozy", sends the
    suggested WhatsApp (`tasks.md:348`) on the person's thread, closes, toast
    "Clinozy is on it · {automation, lower-case}". (6) "3 · Close with · then pick
    what’s next" — outcomes grid `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))`, gap 8px;
    each min-height 56px, padding 9px 12px, `rounded-lg`, label 13px/600 + effect
    11.5px; the first is dark (`primary`), the rest `card` + `border`; hover
    `shadow-md`. Then the outcome note: textarea, 2 rows, vertical resize, 13px,
    padding 8px 10px, aria-label "Outcome note", placeholder "Add a note to the
    outcome (optional)", ≤200 chars, appended as " · {note}".
  - Footer, inside the task column (padding 12px 24px; 12px 20px compact; 12px 16px
    phone; top hairline): "Snooze ⌄" 36px · "Assigned {name} ⌄" 36px (tooltip "Move
    this task to someone else · the previous person stays on it") · "Was {A} → {B}"
    12px after a reassign · "Close" 36px outline at the inline end. **No primary
    button** — the outcomes are the actions. Reassigning moves the task (and a lead
    task's lead) and keeps the previous owner involved; the chat gets "Moved from {A}
    to {B} · {A} stays involved".
  - **Chat column binding** (D32; `tasks.md:126–131`): opening binds, by id, the
    task's lead (`leadId`, S:730) → else the person's lead (`patientId`, S:729 →
    `Lead.patientId`, S:260) → else the person's existing `kind = contact_thread`
    lead (S:261–262, S:1101) →
    else one is created (status and source null, owner me, interest the
    appointment's service) and seeded with "Appointment #{seq} · {service}" or
    "Task · {task title}". The lookup-or-create is one idempotent server op
    (fixture; Appendix F), so a second open of the same person's task **never makes
    a duplicate thread** (the prototype does, H:4272 — and it matches by name). The
    composer starts on the channel of the last inbound message (else last outbound,
    else the default channel, else WhatsApp); the thread's footer line reads "Lead
    created · {when} · via {source}" / "Patient · chat only · no lead" / "Contact ·
    chat only · no lead". Sending never closes the task; a "Reply to {first}" task
    resolves itself once the last message is outbound ("Done by Clinozy · Reply sent
    from the lead chat") and the drawer closes. On open the thread text shows
    skeleton bars until it loads; the task column stays readable.
- **Outcome flow** (`tasks.md:180–233`; H:4293): an outcome writes its effect,
  closes the task, toasts "{task title} · {result}" + "Undo" (5,200ms; Undo
  reverses the side effects too), adds "Task closed · {result}" to the lead's chat,
  and **380ms later** opens "What’s next for {first}?" — except after a snooze,
  "Claim it", "Fix the number" or "Let Clinozy do it". Snoozes toast "Snoozed ·
  {label}" + "Undo"; claim "You now own {name} · {owner} stays involved" + "Undo";
  reassign "{task title} → {name} · {previous first name} stays on it" + "Undo".
  "Tomorrow 10:00" snoozes to 10:00 tomorrow, clinic-local (the prototype adds 24h,
  H:4319). Outcomes whose follow-on is a form (the booking drawer, the visit or
  aftercare check-in, the review log, the patient file) open it **as a stacked child
  drawer over `/tasks`** — the shared form units, no URL (S:116) — with "What’s
  next" on top (AMBER); "Fix the number" and "Call now" open the person's record.
- **"What’s next for {first}?"** (`tasks.md:86–99, 134–146`): stacked child sheet
  `min(560px, 100vw − 56px)` above everything; header 76px (60px phone): title
  18px/600 + "Closed · {task title} · {result}" 13px; section "Next task".
  - Fields: "Next step" chips, full row, each in its tone — "Call again" (sky) ·
    "Send WhatsApp" (sage) · "Book a visit" (lav) · "Collect payment" (peach) · "Send
    offer" (butter), required · "When" chips, full row, `muted` — "In 3 hours" ·
    "Tomorrow 11 am" · "In 3 days" · "Next week", required · "Assigned to" person
    picker, half row, me preselected ("{name} (you)") · "Note" input, half row,
    placeholder "e.g. Ask about the peel price" (becomes the why line).
  - Footer at the inline end: "Nothing next" (outline 36px) · "Create task"
    (`primary` 36px). Missing picks: the error below the field and a toast "Pick the
    next step" / "Pick when" (§7.1). Pending "Saving…"; failure keeps it open with
    "Not saved · your changes are kept", "Retry save" and the 9,000ms toast.
    Success: toast "Next task set · {step} · {when, lower-case}", closes, and a
    "Follow-ups you set" task "{step} · {first}" lands, due in 3h / tomorrow 11:00 /
    in 3 days / in 7 days (`createTask`, S:1727).
  - Dismiss: backdrop, × (no entrance animation), "Nothing next", Esc (§7.3).
    Below `md`: full-screen, × inside top-end 44 × 44, footer wraps with 44px buttons
    and safe-area padding.
- **New task `/tasks/create`** (Q-T4, D24; S:96): the prototype's unreachable 720px

### 6.11 Offerings (`offerings/`, `create/`, `$offeringId/edit/`, `offerings/offers/` + dialogs)

Built by `fe-design-ditto` at phone, tablet and desktop together (D16), with
`fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island`, `fe-resource-crud` (the four dialog
routes), `shadcn`, `fe-http-forms-errors`, `fe-locale-formatting`,
`fe-rtl-logical-css`, `fe-i18n-constants` (namespace `offerings`),
`fe-e2e-testids` and `fe-test-generation`. Spec: `offerings.md`; prototype:
template H:1538–1640, view model H:5450–5529.

**Routes** (§4; `S:98–103`):

- `offerings/` — the Offerings tab page (`S:98`); `offerings/create/` (`?name=`
  prefill, `S:99`) and `offerings/$offeringId/edit/` (`S:100`) are URL-driven
  dialogs over it.
- `offerings/offers/` — the Offers tab page (`S:101`; `status` =
  `live|scheduled|ended|paused`); `offerings/offers/create/` and
  `offerings/offers/$offerId/edit/` (`S:102–103`) over it.
- Tab chrome (toolbar, tab track, New button) lives in `offerings/shared/` (§4).
  The tabs are links, not state; the prototype switches `ofView` (H:5522).
- The stacked "New offering" child drawer has no URL (`S:116`).
- Search schemas: Offerings `q`, `category` (schema), plus `offer`, `branch`,
  `status`, `created`, `sort` (plan additions, D22); Offers `q`, `status`,
  `branch`, `created`. `specialty` is accepted and unused (Q-O6).

**Data** (D6, D22; shared domain, because the Invoice drawer, the booking drawer
and the plan card read it — §3.6):

- `src/shared/api/clinic/offerings-contracts.ts` / `offerings-api.ts` /
  `offerings.fixtures.ts`, shaped on `Offering` and `Offer` (`S:557–600`):
  paise, `seq` shown "#274", `offering_category` (`S:1330`), `offer_kind`
  `percent | amount | fixed | extra` labelled "% off" · "₹ off" · "Fixed price" ·
  "Extra sessions" (`S:1349`), derived state `live` labelled "Running".
  Seeds `OF_SEED` (H:3550) and `OFX_SEED` (H:3583–3587).
- Plan-only fields, fixture + `REPLACE_WITH_API`, Appendix F: offer price,
  availability `branchIds`, `gstInclusive`, search terms, description; an offer's
  open start ("Now") and open end ("no end"). Contract fields with no UI keep
  their defaults: `specialty` (the org's first specialty, Q-O6), `defaultDoctorId`,
  `room`.
- **Pure functions** in `src/shared/api/clinic/offerings-pricing.ts`, unit-tested
  against every seed and shared with the Invoice drawer (§5):
  - `offerState(offer, today)` — the prototype's `ofxState` (H:3588): paused →
    Paused; today before `startsOn` → Scheduled; after `endsOn` → Ended; else
    Running. Clinic-local `YYYY-MM-DD` comparison (`S:7`), never the demo clock
    (D15).
  - `effectivePrice(offering, branchId | null, offers)` — the prototype's
    `ofEff` (H:3589), Q-O2:
    - base = the offer price when it is below the list price, else the list
      price;
    - only Running offers on this offering count; a branch-limited offer counts
      only when the header has exactly one branch picked (H:5453);
    - price offers don't stack — the lowest result wins: % →
      `round(base × (1 − v/100))`, ₹ off → `max(0, base − v)`, fixed →
      `min(base, v)`;
    - extra-session offers don't stack either — the largest wins — but combine
      with a price offer;
    - the result is clamped up to the lowest price; `off` =
      `round((1 − fin / list) × 100)`.
- **Lists:** the catalogue is small, so both tabs read every cursor page up front
  (`src/shared/api/fetch-all-pages.ts`), then search, filter and sort run
  client-side over the whole set — as the prototype, whose filter sections are
  built from the loaded values and whose Price sort uses the billed price
  (`offerings.md:33, 187`). The contract params (`S:1734–1735`) pass through for
  when the API lands. AMBER.

**Toolbar** (`offerings/shared/`; H:1540–1546; `offerings.md:17`;

### 6.12 Users (`users/`, `create/`, `$userId/edit/`, `users/roles/`, `users/branches/` + dialogs)

**D17 (locked): this room is the single members surface.** Team reads clinozy-be
members joined with fixture staff profiles; "New user" sends an invitation, never
an admin-set password; Roles & access edits backend roles plus the fixture clinic
matrix; Settings' Members and Roles sections become links to `/users` and
`/users/roles`. Reuse, don't rebuild: `members.resource.ts`, `useMembers`,
`useInviteMember`, `useResendInvitation`, `useRevokeInvitation`,
`useUpdateMemberRole`, `useUpdateMemberStatus`, `useRemoveMember`, `useRoles`,
`useCreateRole`, `useUpdateRole`, `useDeleteRole`; the data units behind
`InviteMemberDialog` and `CreateRoleDialog` move out of Settings
(`fe-component-promotion`) and are restyled, never duplicated.

Built by `fe-design-ditto` at phone, tablet and desktop together, with
`fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island`, `fe-resource-crud` (members resource and
the four dialog routes), `fe-routing-tenancy` (gates, the preview jump, the `from`
param), `shadcn`, `fe-http-forms-errors`, `fe-resilient-interactions` (optimistic
matrix, deferred remove), `fe-locale-formatting`, `fe-rtl-logical-css`,
`fe-i18n-constants` (namespace `users`; the relocated Settings keys move here),
`fe-e2e-testids` and `fe-test-generation`. Spec: `users.md`; prototype: template
H:1083–1215, view model H:5143–5233.

**Routes** (§4; `S:104–110`):

- `users/` — Team (`role`, `branch`, `q` from the schema; `status`, `created`,
  `sort` added); `users/create/` is the invite drawer; `users/$userId/edit/` the
  member drawer. `$userId` carries the membership id, because clinozy-be keys
  member writes by membership (AMBER).
- A member pill on a role page opens `users/$userId/edit?from=roles`; the validated
  `from` renders the Roles page behind the drawer, as the prototype keeps it
  (H:5188) — the invoices `from` pattern (§4). AMBER.
- `users/roles/` — Roles & access; plan search param `role` = the selected role
  id, default Front desk (H:5179).
- `users/branches/` with `users/branches/create/` and
  `users/branches/$branchId/edit/`.
- Tab chrome in `users/shared/`; the tabs are links (the prototype switches
  `usView`, H:5223).

**Data** (D6, D17, D22):

- **Team** = `useMembers` (clinozy-be memberships: email, platform role, status
  `active | invited | suspended`, live invitation) joined by membership id with a
  fixture staff profile in `src/shared/api/clinic/staff-*` (`seq`, name, phone,
  tone, clinic roles, `branchIds`, `workingDays`, `startsAt`, `endsAt`,
  `commissionPct` — the schema's `User`, `S:184–209`; seeds `US_SEED`
  H:3593–3604) behind `REPLACE_WITH_API`. Every page is read up front
  (`fetch-all-pages.ts`); search over name, email, mobile and "#ID" and the sorts
  run client-side — the contract's `listUsers` searches name, email and phone and
  sorts by name (`S:1746`). AMBER.
- **Roles** = `useRoles` (name, description, member count, system flag) joined with
  the fixture clinic matrix (9 sections × View / Create / Edit / Delete) and the
  11 abilities, keyed by backend role id (§3.7; `US_PERM0` H:3605–3606, `US_ABIL0`
  H:3577). Role tones live in the fixture; backend roles carry none (Appendix F).
  The platform Owner role is not listed (Q-U2); Admin is a system role and locked.
- **Platform mapping** (real API, D17, §3.7): only the matrix's Users row and the
  "Change roles & access" switch are backed by clinozy-be permission codes — Users
  View → `membership:read` + `role:read`; Create → `invitation:manage`; Edit and
  Delete → `membership:manage`; "Change roles & access" → `role:manage` — written
  through `useUpdateRole` (a full replace of `permission_codes`). Every other cell
  writes the fixture matrix. AMBER.
- **Branches** = the shared clinic domain `src/shared/api/clinic/branches-*`
  (fixture; `Branch`, `S:154–181`; seeds `BR_SEED` H:3567–3570). One
  `useBranches()` exposes `openBranches` and `isMultiBranch` to the header picker
  (§3.2), Offerings, the user drawer and every Filters popover.

### 6.13 Visit sheet (`visits/`; D18)

The sheet is now specified in `today.md` (Forms, Popups, Multi-step, States,
Copy — `today.md:76–137, 155–169, 209–212, 245–267`); the prototype is
H:2467–2666 with its view-model at H:4612–4630 and H:6085–6088.

- **Route and model (D18, D24, §4):** `/visits/$visitId` (`visits/` owns the param),
  module `today`; `?tab=timeline*|consult|treatment|checkout` (the prototype's keys,
  H:4614). Opened by Today's lane actions on the tab for the lane (`today.md:159`):
  With doctor → `consult`, Treatment → `treatment`, Checkout → `checkout`; History
  only by its tab. One Visit model with the patient file's 5-step flow (§6.6): check-in
  creates it, each tab writes its own record (clinical, session, bill, pharmacy —
  `today.md:254`), and completing the visit completes the appointment. The Visit is
  plan-only (no Visit entity in the schema, S:352) — fixture + `REPLACE_WITH_API`,
  contracts in `src/shared/api/clinic/visit-*` (two families), Appendix F. Unknown
  `visitId` → `/today` + toast "Visit not found · it may have been deleted" (S:115).
- **Access by tab**, from the records each tab writes: History needs `patients.view`;
  Consult & Rx — Doctor, Admin (the Rx routes, S:35); Treatment — Doctor, Therapist
  (S:38); Checkout — `billing.create` (S:85, S:92), which adds Accountant and Owner
  to §4's list (AMBER). A tab the role can't use is hidden; the route needs any one.
- **Shape** (`today.md:129, 132–137, 193`; H:2468–2470): a fixed, opaque, full-viewport
  layer above the shell (header and `MobileNav` included; the shell stays mounted
  underneath), `card` canvas, no backdrop, **no open / close animation** (0ms). Dialog
  semantics: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, labelled by the patient name; focus moves
  to the name heading on open and returns to the lane card's action on Today (§7.2 —
  the source focuses nothing, `today.md:137`). A transparent full-height "Close visit"
  strip (aria-label and title) fills the space at the inline start (≈12px; not in the
  tab order). Dismiss: "Close · Esc", Esc (H:4512), the strip → `/today` (keeping
  `branch`); it also closes itself after Approve and after Receive; "Full profile"
  closes it and opens `/patients/$patientId/timeline` (D26). The toaster renders
  above it (the prototype's toasts sit under it, z 50 vs 85 — `today.md:107`; H:2468,
  H:2690; §7.3).
- **Header band** (`today.md:134, 246–248`; H:2471–2486): butter (`tone-butter`),
  padding 14px 22px 12px, bottom hairline.
  - Line 1: name 21px/600 heading font, line-height 1, −0.02em · meta 12.5px tabular
    "{F|M} · {age} · {PT-seq} · {masked phone}" (e.g. "F · 29 · PT-0412 · +91 98250
    ··· 41"; ids per D32) · kind pill "Registered patient" (11px, 1px sage line, sage

    is a plan addition, §3.6) · "Visit: {Enquiry|Arriving|Waiting|With doctor|Treatment|
    Checkout|Pharmacy} · since {HH:mm}" (outline; H:4613). A chip whose data is absent

  - Inline end: "Full profile" (12.5px/500, `shadow-sm`) · "Close · Esc" — no ×.

    floor; the sheet closes; toast "₹{amount} received by {mode} · {payment id} ·
    receipt sent on WhatsApp". A partial payment leaves a due and a payment reminder
    task (server). Reopening shows the saved state — a finalised bill stays finalised
    and the amount defaults to the open due (the prototype resets both, H:4554).
- **Phone (D29)** — below `md`, `today.md:130` has no restyle and overflows ≈30px at
  390: the sheet stays full-screen; every column grid stacks to **one column** in
  source order (History list → "Next for this visit"; Relevant history → Consult note
  → Prescription; settings → Photo comparison, its 3 × 2 grid kept; Bill → Payment),
  inline-start hairlines become top hairlines; the sheet scrolls as one page
  (`overflow-y-auto`, `overflow-x-hidden`, no nested scrollers) with safe-area bottom
  padding; header band padding 12px, name / meta / chips wrap; "Full profile" and
  "Close · Esc" and each tab's action (Approve, Complete session, Create bill,
  Receive) follow the phone drawer footer — 44px, full width, wrapping; the tab row
  scrolls sideways with the saved label pinned at its inline end. Verified with no
  horizontal overflow at 375. Tailwind: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[…]` per tab.
  **Tablet:** as desktop (fits at 820 and 1024; at 768 the Consult columns are 240 ·
  246 · 282).
- **States** (`today.md:209–212`): the sheet opens with the visit loaded (skeleton on
  a cold deep link); empties as quoted above; action labels "Approving…",
  "Recording…", "Creating…", "Waiting for server…" — real latency (the prototype's
  750ms commits never fail, H:4551). Failures use the platform errors the source never
  designed: the button returns, the tab row reads "Not saved · your changes are kept"
  and the 9,000ms "Couldn’t save" toast with "Retry" (§6.0, `fe-http-forms-errors`).
- **Icons:** none — "→ ✓ ✗" are text glyphs (`today.md:182`; mirrored in Arabic).
- **Skills:** `fe-design-ditto`, `fe-page-scaffolding` → `fe-route-island`, `shadcn`
  (tabs, dialog semantics), `fe-http-forms-errors` (Rx approve, session, bill,
  payment), `fe-routing-tenancy` (per-tab access), `fe-locale-formatting`,
  `fe-i18n-constants`, `fe-rtl-logical-css`, `fe-e2e-testids`, `fe-test-generation`
  (Rx readiness, balance and partial rules, lane-after-approve / after-receive).

## 7. Deviations

The regenerated specs quote the prototype (D1), so few md-only items remain;
most deviations are the contract (D22), the PRD (D21), project rules, or
prototype defects. Every row lands in `AS-BUILT.md` when it is built.

### 7.2 Project rules over the source

- **Tokens.** Semantic and tone tokens only (`validate:tokens`); none of the
  prototype's hex, `rgb()` or `--z*` / `--k*` values reach components
  (Appendix E). New tokens include `canvas` (`--z50`), `muted-strong`
  (`--z150`), `muted-foreground-strong`, `brand-mark` / `brand-mark-strong` and
  `channel-instagram` (§3.1). Hovers use the shadcn `primary/90` and
  `destructive/90`.
- **Primitives.** shadcn throughout: `sheet`, `drawer` (vaul) for bottom
  sheets, `popover`, `command`, `hover-card`, `tabs`, `toggle-group`,
  `resizable`. The prototype's markup sets the look only, never the DOM. Tables
  are the shared `DataTable` with per-table phone layouts (fold, wrap, regrid).
- **Icons.** Registry only (§3.4), stroke from the icon-weight axis (`thin`,
  1.5). Names carry no digits (`Maximize2 as LuMaximize`). Appearance "System"
  reuses `Monitor`. Text glyphs ("×", "‹ ›", "⚡") become `X`, `ChevronLeft` /
  `ChevronRight`, `Zap`.
- **Copy.** Every string is an i18n key across 11 locales with the parity gate;
  ICU plurals replace "1 people", "1 orders", "0 file". Clinic literals
  ("Cresence Skin", its address and map links) come from org and branch
  settings.
- **Phone and tablet (D10, D23).** Tiers `md` and `xl`, never the prototype's
  760 / 1100. The page h1 is `sr-only` on phone (not removed); the section chip
  has no live region (`RouteAnnouncer` announces the room, AMBER). Everything
  pinned to the bottom rides one bottom-stack contract over `MobileNav`
  (`--floating-bottom-offset`, 58px + safe area): the floating "New" button, the
  View-as / notice pill, toasts and the upload tray. The Sentry feedback trigger
  hides below `md` while a "New" button is mounted. Touch targets are ≥ 44px.
- **Focus and keyboard.** Drawers are modal sheets that trap focus and return
  it, starting on the title (the confirm starts on "Keep it"); disabled actions
  are `aria-disabled` with a visible reason; auto-capitalise lives in the text
  field unit, not a document listener.
- **Delete confirm** is the project's reason confirm: a panel from `md`, a
  bottom sheet below (`docs/reference/design.md:148–152`), Undo for 10s through
  restore (D32).
- **Toasts** default to bottom-centre (a platform-wide default with a
  migration), sit above every overlay and keep the platform's stack of 4.
- **Settings** stays the `#settings/*` hash modal; the Account menu carries the
  relocated platform rows (Switch clinic, Notifications, Settings, Security,
  Billing, Devices, Keyboard shortcuts) and its Members and Roles sections link
  to the Users room (D17).
- **Fonts** are self-hosted (`@fontsource`; CSP `font-src 'self'`).
- **Auth.** "Log out" calls `logout({ reason })` and the platform lands on
  `/login`; the signed-out overlay (H:515) is not built.
- **Behaviour is env-driven** (D15): no simulated latency, failure rates,
  clock clamp or demo people; fixture rooms are gated through
  `VITE_DISABLED_MODULES` (D8). Times and dates go through `useLocaleFormat` in
  the clinic's timezone, with the hour cycle from Appearance.
- **No inferred API contracts.** Fixtures with `REPLACE_WITH_API`, shaped on
  `schema-routes.md` (D22); no `apiClient` literal for a route clinozy-be doesn't
  serve. Display ids are the schema's `seq` with prefixes (`PAY-`, `INV-`, …).
- **Privacy.** `name` and `phone` join `SENSITIVE_QUERY_PARAMS`
  (`src/lib/telemetry-scrub.ts:15`) because `leads/create?name=&phone=` and
  `patients/create` carry them (`S:23`, `S:31`); recent picks store ids, never
  values; "Dictate a draft" is not built.
- **Corner radius.** Named radius steps follow the Corner radius axis (the
  tab-bar's 10px becomes `rounded-lg`); pills carry `data-slot="pill"`.
- **Right-to-left.** Arabic is a UI locale, so layouts use logical properties
  (`validate:logical`): drawers anchor to the inline end, the floating × sits
  outside the inline-start edge, sticky row actions and the floating "New"
  button sit at the inline end, the patient-file rail at the inline start, and
  directional glyphs mirror.
- **Layout by container.** The appointment form stacks below 520px of its own
  width; the Day close review re-grids below 770px; the patient-file bento and
  suggestions keep the prototype's container queries (H:307–309, H:418–422).

design on purpose. `AS-BUILT.md` › Standing deviations is seeded from it as rows
are built; every §7.3 fix is a standing deviation too.

## 8. Verification plan

1. **Side-by-side, per screen, per state:**
   - Viewports, all for fidelity (D10): **375px** (phone), **820px and
     1024px** (tablet) and **1440px** (desktop), plus the D23 boundaries —
     767 / 768px and 1279 / 1280px — where the layout must switch cleanly. The
     source is checked at 390 / 820 / 1024 / 1440 (its own references) and the
     build at 375 / 820 / 1024 / 1440. Light and dark.
   - States: default, loading, empty, filtered-empty, error toast, view-only,
     each drawer and popover open, and every input-dependent step variant
     (New lead ×4, Pay ×2, Offering ×2). On phone also: the tab bar with the
     current room pinned and unpinned ("More" taking its label), every bottom
     sheet (picker, Filters, All sections, Patient file sections), the floating
     "New" button, full-width drawers with the × inside, the lead drawer's
     Details · Chat panes, the Roles list → detail → "Back to roles", the
     Appointments Day strip, the Stock check cards, the Day close strip and the
     Visit sheet (D29: no horizontal overflow at 375px).
   - Known source defects are compared against the source's intent, not its
     render (§7.3): the tab bar sits below the screen in a plain browser (D30).
   - Source: serve `iterations/launch-2026-09-30-jxmr/` from a local static server — the runtime
     re-fetches its own URL and loads React from unpkg (I2), so `file://`
     fails. Open it in the in-app browser at the same viewport and click to the
     same room and state.
   - Per screen, walk the UI against the source: text, font size, colour,
     background, spacing, radius, border, shadow, icons, layout, states and
     motion (`kickoff-iteration-prompt.md`, Verify & close).
   - One right-to-left pass per screen, in Arabic at 1440px.
2. **Static gates, every PR:**

   ```bash
   pnpm validate:tokens && pnpm validate:theme-axis && pnpm validate:structure && pnpm validate:testids && pnpm type-check && pnpm lint
   ```

   Plus `pnpm validate:logical`, `pnpm validate:i18n`, `pnpm validate:i18n-parity`, `pnpm sync:check`,
   `pnpm build:check` (rooms stay lazy; nothing heavy on the entry chunk) and
   `pnpm biome:check`.

3. **Unit tests** (`fe-test-generation`), colocated per unit, with `vitest-axe`
   (portaled dialogs through `axeForDialog`). Pure-function suites for:
   `pyTot`, `ofEff`, `offerState`, hold/claim, the appointment status guards,
   calendar geometry and load bars, fold ranking and the phone key column
   (H:4112, H:4125), stock runway, the Rx quick-line parser, the invoice
   quick-line parser, the role-home resolver (D25) and `useViewportTier`.
4. **Contrast test** for the preset's text pairs (L-05), proved both ways: it
   fails on the 4.40 pair, passes on the fix.
5. **Coverage:** changed lines ≥ 90% (`pnpm coverage:patch`); the coverage
   ratchet and the TSDoc budget never drop.
6. **E2E, local only** (clinozy-be on :3000): a smoke spec per room with hybrid
   selectors, run at desktop and at the phone viewport; deep-link specs for a
   sample of the 61 dialog routes (direct hit renders the parent page, then the
   drawer; unknown id → parent + toast, `S:115`). After fidelity sign-off, light and dark baselines per route (`fe-visual-regression`), and the axe lane (`tests/e2e/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`).
7. **Recap** (`fe-design-ditto` Step 6): the closed ledger, what was built,
   what still differs from the source and why, and what couldn't be verified.
8. **Close and freeze:** when every row is `done` (or `deferred` with the user's
   OK) and `AS-BUILT.md` has its summary, run
   `pnpm iteration:status launch-2026-09-30-jxmr done`; `frozen` goes in the last
   commit before this iteration's branch merges to `main`. After the merge the
   folder is never edited; a correction is a new `fix` iteration.

## 9. The route — the ordered ledger

MODE initial route order: the gate → foundation (preset with contrast
recomputed and all four registration points → shell as a new variant made live
→ stores → icons → shared primitives and the data layer) → the screens in D16
order, each built interaction shell → flow skeleton → regions at phone, tablet
and desktop → content → states → motion → verification. Status:
`open | in progress | done | deferred (user-OK)`; Assignee is `—` until someone
takes the row. **Success may not be reported while any row is open.** Each
screen row's detail is in its §6 block.

### C.2 RED questions — answered 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-03

**RED-1 · Users room vs the Settings members and roles panels.**

- **Evidence:**
  - The prototype's Users room has Team, Roles & access and Branches
    (H:1083–1218).
  - Its user drawer sets a password and "Active · can sign in" (H:5167,
    H:5175); its invite code is dead (H:3336, H:5556–5557).
  - The platform already manages members, invitations, roles and role
    permissions in the `#settings/*` modal, backed by clinozy-be.
- **Options:**
  - **A.** The Users room becomes the one members surface. Team lists the
    backend members joined with fixture staff profiles. "New user" sends an
    invitation (no admin-set passwords). Roles & access edits the backend roles
    plus the fixture clinic matrix. Settings' Members and Roles sections become
    links into the room.
  - **B.** Settings stays the members surface. The Users room holds Branches and
    the clinic access matrix, and Team links to Settings.
  - **C.** Build the prototype as is, with admin-set passwords. This conflicts
    with the platform's invite and verification model; not recommended.
- **Recommendation: A.** **Answer: A** — locked as D17.

**RED-2 · Two visit workspaces.**

- **Evidence:** Today's Visit sheet (H:2467–2666) and the patient file's
  5-step visit flow (H:758, H:5001) are both live. Neither has an md, neither is
  linked to the appointment's check-in, and they share no data (both are
  static).
- **Options:**
  - **A.** One Visit model; both surfaces built as designed — the sheet from
    Today, the flow from the patient file. Check-in starts the visit, and
    completing the visit completes the appointment.
  - **B.** The sheet is the only workspace; "Start visit" opens it.
  - **C.** The flow is the only workspace; Today's lane actions open the patient
    file.
- **Recommendation: A** — ditto builds what's designed, on one model. **Answer: A** — locked as D18.

**RED-3 · Patient-file "Overview" and the default section.**

- **Evidence:**
  - "Overview" is a nav label (H:4924), but its bento (H:769–779) and timeline
    (H:4840–4864) can't be reached: the tab resolves to Clinical notes (H:4722)
    and `isTimeline` is never true (H:5001).
  - Opening a patient by name selects no tab (H:4485, H:4940).
  - `patient-file.md` names no default.
- **Options:**
  - **A.** Ship Overview (bento + timeline) as the default section.
  - **B.** Drop Overview; Clinical notes is the default, and the Overview slot
    shows the running visit, as the prototype does.
- **Recommendation: A** — it's designed, only unwired, and gives the file a summary landing. **Answer: A** — locked as D19.

**RED-4 · Today's stage machine.**

- **Evidence:**
  - the earlier `today.md` had 8 stages, including Done (the regenerated spec has
    7 lanes, `today.md:19`); the prototype has 7 lanes
    (H:577–654).
  - "Book" (enquiry) and "Dispense" (pharmacy) never move their cards out
    (H:4646, H:4659), so nothing says when those cards leave.
- **Proposed rules:**
  - An enquiry card leaves once its lead has an appointment; it then shows in
    Arriving on that day.
  - A pharmacy card leaves once its sale exists, paid or not.
  - A Done lane per the md: today's completed visits, collapsed by default.
- **Recommendation:** these rules, with the Done lane. **Answer: keep the prototype's behaviour** — 7 lanes, no Done lane, cards stay in their lanes; locked as D20.

## Appendix E — Colour map (every prototype colour variable)

Generated from H:11 (light) and H:12 (dark) against the tokens in §3.1 and
recounted against the current prototype. ΔE is the OKLab distance, the larger of
light and dark. "Uses" counts live `var(--…)` references, including the ones
made through the prototype's aliases (`--color-bg`, `--color-surface`,
`--color-text`, `--color-divider`, `--color-neutral-*`, `--color-accent-*`,
`--primary`, `--ring`; H:196–202, H:240), and leaves out the declaration lines
and the dead regions of B.12 (Blueprint H:2216–2466, `ProfileLogic` and `Ring`
H:3074–3078 and H:3157–3276, the generic table room H:1643–1670 and
H:5532–5575, the sub-tab header H:557–575), which are shown as "+n dead". "First
live use" gives the first two lines.

The neutral rows use the raw `--z*` names (`preset.md:25–43`): the `Alias`
column is the prototype's `--color-neutral-*` name, one step lower than the
zinc number, and `--z800` has none. The previous version of this table keyed
`background` to `--z50`; the page is `--z0` (H:203, H:522), so `--z50` becomes
the new `canvas` token, `--z150` is `muted-strong` (not a hover wash: the hover
fill is `--z100` = `accent`), and `--z800`, whose uses are 76 hover fills out
of 83, maps to the `primary` hover rather than to a text token.

Statuses: "exact" and "new token" rows carry the value as is (74 rows, 7,612
live uses); "nearest" rows are within 0.03 (30 rows, 83 uses); "nearest —
verify" rows are farther and get a side-by-side check (33 rows, 137 uses,
L-57); "dead — not built" rows are referenced only by B.12 code (3 rows).
Overrides of the computed nearest token are noted in the row (`--k60`,
`--k111`). Hover rows (`--z800`, `--k37`) use the shadcn button's own hover,
`/90` over the fill, measured over `card`. One raw literal also becomes a token:
`#DD2A7B` (H:5770, H:5803) → `channel-instagram`, at the AA value in §3.1
(ΔE 0.018 light, 0.073 dark from the raw hex; verify, L-57). `--k105`'s dark
value moves by 0.060 for the same reason.

## Appendix F — Backend dependencies (for clinozy-be)

Every room ships on fixtures shaped on `schema-routes.md` (D6, D22), so
swapping in the API changes no UI. Each row unblocks its rooms in production
(D8, L-60). "Contract" is what clinozy-be builds from the shared schema;
"Beyond the schema" is what the prototype's UI needs that the contract lacks or
differs on — each is a request, a fixture field marked `REPLACE_WITH_API`, and a
row to settle before that room's module is enabled.

| Domain                       | Contract (`schema-routes.md`)                                                                                                | Beyond the schema (requests)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Unblocks                                                    |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Clinic permissions and roles | the role enum and role × section × V/C/E/D matrix (`S:211–225, 996–1021`)                                                    | the 11 abilities (enforce `void`, `refund`, `dayclose`, `disc`, `floor`, `perms`); custom roles; the matrix keyed by role id; more than one role per membership; `canDelete` requiring View (not Edit); map `billing.*` route gates to a real `section` value; seed the 7 clinic roles + Marketing with purposes and tones; role-permission audit (Q-U6). clinozy-be's roles API returns only Admin / Member / Viewer today — the riskiest dependency                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | in-room gating everywhere (D9), Users                       |
| Users and staff              | User (`S:184–210`) and its operations (`S:1742–1754`)                                                                        | invitation-based create (no password, C29, D17); staff-profile fields on the membership — `seq`, phone, tone, working days and hours, commission, branches; firstName / lastName without breaking "Dr."; membership removal with reason, note and a 10s restore; presence (`S:1571`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Users, Appointments (slots), Today, team card               |
| Branches                     | Branch CRUD (`S:154–183`)                                                                                                    | area, city, PIN, phone and email optional (the prototype requires name and address line 1); one write to set a branch's team; maps and review links for message templates                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Users, header branch picker, print identity, bookable hours |
